continent:Africa.title: Africa
continent:Africa.text: Africa is the second largest continent on Earth. It makes up about one-fifth of the world's total land area. It is surrounded by large areas of water.

continent:Asia.title: Asia
continent:Asia.text: Asia is the largest continent on Earth by area and number of people. It is mainly in the northern hemisphere. Asia is connected to Europe in the west and Africa on the south, and separated from North America at the east.

continent:Europe.title: Europe
continent:Europe.text: Europe is the western part of the continent of Eurasia, often thought of as its own continent. It is separated from Asia by the Ural Mountains in Russia and the Bosporus strait in Turkey.

continent:South America.title: South America
continent:South America.text: South America is the continent to the south of North America. These two continents are separated by the Panama Canal. There are seven continents which make up the globe, South America being the 4th largest.

continent:Australia.title: Australia (continent)
continent:Australia.text: The continent of Australia, sometimes known technically as Sahul, Australia-New Guinea, Australinea, or Meganesia to distinguish it from the country of Australia, is a continent located in the Southern and Eastern hemispheres.

continent:Antarctica.title: Antarctica
continent:Antarctica.text: Antarctica is the Earth's southernmost and the continent with the least people. It is on the South Pole. It is almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle.

continent:Oceania.title: Oceania
continent:Oceania.text: Oceania is a large geographical region in the Pacific Ocean. It is made up of 14 countries in the surrounding area. It is often listed as one of the continents in the world.

country:Zimbabwe.title: Zimbabwe
country:Zimbabwe.text: The Republic of Zimbabwe is a country in the southern part of the continent of Africa. Its capital city is Harare.

country:Zambia.title: Zambia
country:Zambia.text: The Republic of Zambia is a country in southern Africa. It shares its borders with the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the north, Tanzania to the northeast, Malawi to the east, Mozambique to the southeast, Zimbabwe and Botswana to the south, Namibia to the southwest, and Angola to the west. It used to be called Northern Rhodesia and it is currently named after the Zambezi River.

country:Yemen.title: Yemen
country:Yemen.text: Yemen, officially the Republic of Yemen is a nation in the Middle East. It is the old North Yemen and South Yemen, in the southwestern corner of the Arabian Peninsula. It borders Saudi Arabia and Oman on the north and the east.

country:Vietnam.title: Vietnam
country:Vietnam.text: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam is a country in Southeast Asia. The neighboring countries are Cambodia, China, and Laos. The capital is Hanoi.

country:Venezuela.title: Venezuela
country:Venezuela.text: Venezuela, officially the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, is a country in northern South America. The official language is Spanish, and the capital city is Caracas.

country:Vanuatu.title: Vanuatu
country:Vanuatu.text: Vanuatu is a country in the Pacific Ocean. The official languages of Vanuatu are Bislama, English and French. In 2020, 300,019 people lived in Vanuatu.

country:Uzbekistan.title: Uzbekistan
country:Uzbekistan.text: Uzbekistan, officially the Republic of Uzbekistan, is a country in Central Asia. Its capital and largest city is Tashkent. There are about 37,5 million people living in Uzbekistan, in 2023.

country:Uruguay.title: Uruguay
country:Uruguay.text: Uruguay is a country in South America. The language spoken there is Spanish. Its capital and largest city is Montevideo. Uruguay is bordered by two large neighbors, Brazil and Argentina.

country:Micronesia.title: Federated States of Micronesia
country:Micronesia.text: Micronesia, officially the Federated States of Micronesia, is an island nation in the Pacific Ocean, northeast of Papua New Guinea. The country is a sovereign state in free association with the United States. The capital city of Federated States of Micronesia is Palikir, Pohnpei.

country:Marshall Is..title: Marshall Islands
country:Marshall Is..text: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) is a Micronesian island nation in the western Pacific Ocean. As of 2018, about 58,000 people live there. The capital of Marshall Islands is Majuro.

country:N. Mariana Is..title: Northern Mariana Islands
country:N. Mariana Is..text: The Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, usually shortened to the Northern Mariana Islands, is a group of islands in the Pacific Ocean that are a political division controlled by the United States. Its capital is Saipan.

country:Guam.title: Guam
country:Guam.text: Guam is an island in Micronesia in the Pacific Ocean and is a U.S. territory. This means that it is part of the United States and citizens of Guam are citizens of the United States as well.

country:American Samoa.title: American Samoa
country:American Samoa.text: American Samoa is a territory of the United States. It is part of the Samoan Islands in the southern Pacific Ocean.

country:Puerto Rico.title: Puerto Rico
country:Puerto Rico.text: Puerto Rico, officially the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, is a self-governing Caribbean archipelago and island organized as an unincorporated territory of the United States under the designation of commonwealth. Located about 1,000 miles (1,600 km) southeast of Miami, Florida, between the Dominican Republic in the Greater Antilles and the U.S.

country:United States of America.title: United States
country:United States of America.text: The United States of America, also known as the United States or America, is a country that is located in North America. It is made of 50 states, a federal district, and some other territories and insular areas. Forty-eight of the states are connected, and they are bordered by Canada to the north and Mexico to the south.

country:S. Geo. and the Is..title: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
country:S. Geo. and the Is..text: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands (SGSSI) is a British Overseas Territory in the southern Atlantic Ocean. It is a remote and inhospitable collection of islands, consisting of South Georgia and a chain of smaller islands known as the South Sandwich Islands. South Georgia is 165 kilometres (103 mi) long and 35 kilometres (22 mi) wide and is by far the largest island in the territory.

country:Br. Indian Ocean Ter..title: British Indian Ocean Territory
country:Br. Indian Ocean Ter..text: The British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT) is a British Overseas Territory situated in the Indian Ocean. The territory comprises the seven atolls of the Chagos Archipelago with over 1,000 individual islands, many very small, amounting to a total land area of 60 square kilometres.

country:Saint Helena.title: Saint Helena
country:Saint Helena.text: Saint Helena is a volcanic tropical island located in the South Atlantic Ocean, west of Africa. The nearest countries geographically are Angola and Namibia. The island is about 1,860 km (1,160 mi) west of Angola, 3,280 km (2,040 mi) east of Brazil and South America, and 4,000 km (2,500 mi) east of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

country:Anguilla.title: Anguilla
country:Anguilla.text: Anguilla is a group of five islands in the Caribbean Sea. The islands are ruled by the United Kingdom.

country:Falkland Is..title: Falkland Islands
country:Falkland Is..text: The Falkland Islands, commonly referred to as the Falklands, is an archipelago in the South Atlantic Ocean on the Patagonian Shelf. The principal islands are about 300 mi (500 km) east of South America's southern Patagonian coast and 752 mi (1,210 km) from Cape Dubouzet at the northern tip of the Antarctic Peninsula, at a latitude of about 52°S.

country:Cayman Is..title: Cayman Islands
country:Cayman Is..text: The Cayman Islands are a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean Sea. The territory is made up of three islands: Grand Cayman, Little Cayman, and Cayman Brac. Its capital, George Town, is on the main island.

country:Bermuda.title: Bermuda
country:Bermuda.text: Bermuda is a British Overseas Territory in the North Atlantic Ocean. The closest land outside the territory is in the US state of North Carolina, about 1,035 km (643 mi) to the west-northwest.

country:British Virgin Is..title: British Virgin Islands
country:British Virgin Is..text: The British Virgin Islands is a British Overseas Territory and are part of the Virgin Islands, a chain of islands in the Caribbean. The islands comprise of the eastern half of the island chain. The British Virgin Islands has sixteen inhabited islands and more than twenty uninhabited islands.

country:Turks and Caicos Is..title: Turks and Caicos Islands
country:Turks and Caicos Is..text: Turks and Caicos Islands is a British Overseas Territory consisting of the larger Caicos Islands and smaller Turks Islands, two groups of tropical islands in the Lucayan Archipelago of the Atlantic Ocean and northern West Indies. They are known primarily for tourism and as an offshore financial centre.

country:Montserrat.title: Montserrat
country:Montserrat.text: Montserrat is a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean. It is part of the Leeward Islands, the northern portion of the Lesser Antilles chain of the West Indies. Montserrat is about 16 km (10 mi) long and 11 km (7 mi) wide, with roughly 40 km (25 mi) of coastline.

country:Jersey.title: Jersey
country:Jersey.text: Jersey, officially the Bailiwick of Jersey, is an autonomous and self-governing British Crown Dependency in Northwestern Europe 14 miles (23 km) off the Cotentin Peninsula of north-west France. At 45 square miles (120 km2), the main island, Jersey, is the largest of the Channel Islands.

country:Guernsey.title: Bailiwick of Guernsey
country:Guernsey.text: The Bailiwick of Guernsey is a self-governing British Crown Dependency off the coast of Normandy, France, comprising several islands of the Channel Islands. It has a total land area of 78 square kilometres (30 mi2) and an estimated total population of 67,336.

country:Isle of Man.title: Isle of Man
country:Isle of Man.text: The Isle of Man, also known simply as Man or Mann, is a self-governing British Crown Dependency in the Irish Sea, between Great Britain and Ireland. As head of state, Charles III holds the title Lord of Mann and is represented by a Lieutenant Governor.

country:United Kingdom.title: United Kingdom
country:United Kingdom.text: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, commonly known as the United Kingdom (UK) or Britain, is a country in Northwestern Europe, off the coast of the continental mainland. It comprises England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, with a population of over 69 million in 2025.

country:United Arab Emirates.title: United Arab Emirates
country:United Arab Emirates.text: The United Arab Emirates (UAE), also known simply as the Emirates, is a country in West Asia, situated at the eastern end of the Arabian Peninsula. It is a federal semi-constitutional monarchy made up of seven emirates, with Abu Dhabi serving as its national capital. The UAE borders Oman to the east and northeast, and Saudi Arabia to the south and southwest.

country:Ukraine.title: Ukraine
country:Ukraine.text: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It is the second-largest country in Europe after Russia, which borders it to the east and northeast. Ukraine also borders Belarus to the north; Poland and Slovakia to the west; Hungary, Romania and Moldova to the southwest; and the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov to the south and southeast.

country:Uganda.title: Uganda
country:Uganda.text: Uganda, officially the Republic of Uganda, is a landlocked country in East Africa. It is bordered to the east by Kenya, to the north by South Sudan, to the west by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to the south-west by Rwanda, and to the south by Tanzania. The southern part includes a substantial portion of Lake Victoria, shared with Kenya and Tanzania.

country:Turkmenistan.title: Turkmenistan
country:Turkmenistan.text: Turkmenistan, formerly known as Turkmenia, is a landlocked country in Central Asia, bordered by Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan to the north, Afghanistan to the southeast, Iran to the south and southwest, and the Caspian Sea to the west. It is one of six independent Turkic states. Ashgabat is the capital and largest city.

country:Turkey.title: Turkey
country:Turkey.text: Turkey, officially the Republic of Türkiye, is a transcontinental country located mainly on the Anatolian Peninsula in Western Asia, with a small portion on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe.

country:Tunisia.title: Tunisia
country:Tunisia.text: Tunisia, officially the Tunisian Republic, is a country in the Arab Maghreb in North Africa. It shares its borders with two countries including Algeria to the west, and Libya to the southeast. Tunis is the capital and largest city.

country:Trinidad and Tobago.title: Trinidad and Tobago
country:Trinidad and Tobago.text: Trinidad and Tobago is a country in the south Caribbean Sea. It is 11 km away from Venezuela. The country has two bigger islands, Trinidad and Tobago, and many smaller islands.

country:Tonga.title: Tonga
country:Tonga.text: Tonga is a country in Pacific Ocean. It has 169 islands. Only 36 islands have inhabitants. The most important island is Tongatapu.

country:Togo.title: Togo
country:Togo.text: Togo is a small country in West Africa. It is bordered by Ghana to the west, Benin to the east and Burkina Faso to the north. The capital city Lomé is located along the Gulf of Guinea.

country:Timor-Leste.title: East Timor
country:Timor-Leste.text: East Timor or the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste is a country in Southeast Asia. It is on the eastern side of the island of Timor. It also includes the smaller islands of Atauro and Jaco Island, and a small area, named Oecusse, inside the west side of Timor.

country:Thailand.title: Thailand
country:Thailand.text: Thailand, officially the Kingdom of Thailand ), is a country in Southeast Asia. Its neighbours are Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Myanmar. Its name was Siam until June 1939 and between 1945 and May 11 1949.

country:Tanzania.title: Tanzania
country:Tanzania.text: Tanzania is a country in East Africa. The official languages are Kiswahili and English. It is next to Africa's biggest lake, Lake Victoria.

country:Tajikistan.title: Tajikistan
country:Tajikistan.text: Tajikistan is a country in Central Asia. It was previously part of the Soviet Union. Tajikistan is a republic. The capital city is Dushanbe.

country:Taiwan.title: Taiwan
country:Taiwan.text: The Republic of China, commonly known as Taiwan, is a self-governing country in East Asia. The Republic of China once governed all of China but moved to the island of Taiwan after their defeat in a Chinese civil war.

country:Syria.title: Syria
country:Syria.text: Syria, officially the Syrian Arab Republic, is a country in West Asia. It is located in the Eastern Mediterranean and the Levant. It borders Turkey to the north and northwest, Iraq to the east and southeast, Jordan to the south, and Israel and Lebanon to the southwest.

country:Switzerland.title: Switzerland
country:Switzerland.text: Switzerland is a country in Western Europe. Switzerland is a federation of 26 cantons.

country:Sweden.title: Sweden
country:Sweden.text: Sweden is a Nordic country in the part of Europe called Scandinavia. Its neighbors are Finland and Norway. It is a developed country.

country:eSwatini.title: Eswatini
country:eSwatini.text: Eswatini is a country in Africa. It is officially the Kingdom of eSwatini. It was called Swaziland until April 2018.

country:Suriname.title: Suriname
country:Suriname.text: Suriname or Surinam is a country in South America. The official name of the country is Republiek Suriname. It used to be known as Nederlands Guyana, Netherlands Guiana or Dutch Guiana.

country:S. Sudan.title: South Sudan
country:S. Sudan.text: South Sudan is a country in East Africa. Its official name is the Republic of South Sudan. It was part of Sudan until 2011.

country:Sudan.title: Sudan
country:Sudan.text: Sudan is a country in East Africa. The official name of Sudan is The Republic of the Sudan. Its capital and largest city is Khartoum.

country:Sri Lanka.title: Sri Lanka
country:Sri Lanka.text: The Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka is a tropical island nation located in the Indian Ocean just off the Southern coast of India. The capital of the country is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte while the largest city is Colombo. Sri Lanka shares a sea boundary with the Maldives in the south-west and India in the north-west.

country:Spain.title: Spain
country:Spain.text: Spain is a country in Europe that controls much of the Iberian Peninsula and nearby islands. The people of Spain are called Spaniards, and in 2026, the population of Spain was about 49.8 million. The capital and most populous city is Madrid.

country:South Korea.title: South Korea
country:South Korea.text: South Korea is a country in the southern part of the Korean peninsula, in East Asia.

country:South Africa.title: South Africa
country:South Africa.text: South Africa, officially called the Republic of South Africa, is a country in the southern region of Africa. About fifty-seven million people live there. South Africa is next to Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, and Eswatini, but encloses Lesotho.

country:Somalia.title: Somalia
country:Somalia.text: Somalia, officially called the Federal Republic of Somalia, is a country located on the Horn of Africa. It used to be known as the Somali Republic.

country:Somaliland.title: Somaliland
country:Somaliland.text: Somaliland, officially the Somaliland Protectorate is a de facto country that used to be the former protectorate of British Somaliland. Djibouti lies to the west of Somaliland, the Federal Republic of Ethiopia lies to the south and west and Somalia lies to the east and south.

country:Solomon Is..title: Solomon Islands
country:Solomon Is..text: Solomon Islands are a group of islands in the South Pacific that make up a country. They are known for their beauty and for the many languages spoken there. The capital of Solomon Islands is Honiara.

country:Slovakia.title: Slovakia
country:Slovakia.text: Slovakia is a landlocked country in the eastern region of Central Europe. It is bordered by Austria in the southwest, Hungary in the south, Ukraine in the east, Poland in the north and Czech Republic in the northwest. Its capital city is Bratislava, the only capital of the world that borders two other countries.

country:Slovenia.title: Slovenia
country:Slovenia.text: Slovenia is a country in the region of Central Europe. The capital and largest city of Slovenia is Ljubljana. Its major language is Slovenian.

country:Singapore.title: Singapore
country:Singapore.text: Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is a sovereign country. It is nicknamed as 'The Lion City', 'The Garden City' or 'The Little Red Dot'. It is an island state at the southern end of the Malay Peninsula in Southeast Asia, between the Straits of Malacca and the South China Sea.

country:Sierra Leone.title: Sierra Leone
country:Sierra Leone.text: Sierra Leone is a country in West Africa. Its capital is Freetown. The official language is English.

country:Seychelles.title: Seychelles
country:Seychelles.text: Seychelles is an African country in the Indian Ocean. Its capital city is Victoria. The official languages are Creole, English, and French.

country:Serbia.title: Serbia
country:Serbia.text: Serbia, officially the Republic of Serbia, is a country in Southeastern Europe, and a part of the Balkans. The capital city is Belgrade. To the north of Serbia is the country Hungary.

country:Senegal.title: Senegal
country:Senegal.text: The Republic of Senegal is a country in West Africa. The capital is Dakar. Senegal covers a land area of almost 197,000 square kilometres.

country:Saudi Arabia.title: Saudi Arabia
country:Saudi Arabia.text: Saudi Arabia (Arabic: السعودية as-Su‘ūdiyyah or as-Sa‘ūdiyya), officially known as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) (Arabic: المملكة العربية السعودية al-Mamlakatu 'l-‘Arabiyyatu 's-Su‘ūdiyyah), is a country in West Asia including most of the Arabian Peninsula.

country:São Tomé and Principe.title: São Tomé and Príncipe
country:São Tomé and Principe.text: São Tomé and Príncipe, officially the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe is an island nation in Central Africa, it is located off the Gulf of Guinea. The main islands of São Tomé and Príncipe are about 140 km apart and about 250 and 225 km, respectively, off of the northwestern coast of Gabon.

country:San Marino.title: San Marino
country:San Marino.text: San Marino, officially the Republic of San Marino, is a landlocked country in Southern Europe, completely surrounded by Italy. Located on the northeastern slopes of the Apennine Mountains, it is the larger of two microstates within the Italian Peninsula, the other being Vatican City.

country:Samoa.title: Samoa
country:Samoa.text: The Independent State of Samoa is a country in the Pacific Ocean. It became independent from New Zealand in 1962. It has two islands, including Upolu and Savai'i.

country:St. Vin. and Gren..title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
country:St. Vin. and Gren..text: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is an island nation in the Caribbean Sea. It is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations, the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States and CARICOM.

country:Saint Lucia.title: Saint Lucia
country:Saint Lucia.text: Saint Lucia is an island country in the eastern and southern Caribbean. Part of the Windward Islands of the Lesser Antilles, it is located north/northeast of the island of Saint Vincent, northwest of Barbados and south of Martinique. It covers a land area of 617 km2 (238 sq mi) with an officially estimated population of over 184,100 people as of mid 2023.

country:St. Kitts and Nevis.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis
country:St. Kitts and Nevis.text: Saint Kitts and Nevis (SKN), officially the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis, is an island country located in the Caribbean consisting of the two islands of Saint Kitts and Nevis, in the Leeward Islands chain of the Lesser Antilles.

country:Rwanda.title: Rwanda
country:Rwanda.text: Rwanda is a country in East Africa. It is landlocked, meaning it has no ocean coast. Rwanda is sometimes called the “Land of a Thousand Hills” because it has many mountains and hills.

country:Russia.title: Russia
country:Russia.text: Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country in Eastern Europe and North Asia. It is the largest country in the world, spanning eleven time zones and sharing land borders with fourteen countries. With a population of over 140 million, Russia is the most populous country in Europe and the ninth-most populous in the world.

country:Romania.title: Romania
country:Romania.text: Romania is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe. It lies on the lower course of the Danube, north of the Balkan Peninsula, and on the northwestern shore of the Black Sea. It borders Ukraine to the north and east, Hungary to the west, Serbia to the southwest, Bulgaria to the south, Moldova to the east, and the Black Sea to the southeast.

country:Qatar.title: Qatar
country:Qatar.text: Qatar, officially the State of Qatar, is a country in West Asia. It occupies the Qatar Peninsula on the northeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula in the Middle East; it shares its sole land border with Saudi Arabia to the south, with the rest of its territory surrounded by the Persian Gulf. The Gulf of Bahrain, an inlet of the Persian Gulf, separates Qatar from nearby Bahrain.

country:Portugal.title: Portugal
country:Portugal.text: Portugal is a country in Southern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula. It is bordered by the North Atlantic Ocean to the west and south and by Spain to the north and east. Its capital city is Lisbon.

country:Poland.title: Poland
country:Poland.text: Poland is a country in the eastern region of Central Europe. Its official name is Republic of Poland. It is on the east of Germany.

country:Philippines.title: Philippines
country:Philippines.text: The Philippines is an island country in Southeast Asia in the Pacific Ocean. It has 7,641 islands. The capital city of the Philippines is Manila.

country:Peru.title: Peru
country:Peru.text: Peru, officially the Republic of Peru, is a country in western South America. It is bordered to the north by Ecuador and Colombia, to the east by Brazil, to the southeast by Bolivia, to the south by Chile, and to the south and west by the Pacific Ocean.

country:Paraguay.title: Paraguay
country:Paraguay.text: Paraguay, officially the Republic of Paraguay, is a landlocked country located in the central region of South America. It borders Bolivia to the northwest and north, Brazil to the northeast and east, and Argentina to the southeast, south, and west. Paraguay has access to the Atlantic Ocean via the Paraná–Paraguay Waterway, a system of navigable channels shared by five countries.

country:Papua New Guinea.title: Papua New Guinea
country:Papua New Guinea.text: Papua New Guinea (PNG), officially the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, is an island nation in Oceania that comprises the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia, a region of the southwestern Pacific Ocean north of Australia. It has a land border with Indonesia to the west and maritime borders with Australia to the south and the Solomon Islands to the east. Its capital is Port Moresby.

country:Panama.title: Panama
country:Panama.text: Panama, officially the Republic of Panama, is a country located at the southern end of Central America in North America, bordering South America. It is bordered by Costa Rica to the west, Colombia to the southeast, the Caribbean Sea to the north, and the Pacific Ocean to the south. Its capital and largest city is Panama City, whose metropolitan area is home to nearly half of the country's over 4 million inhabitants.

country:Palau.title: Palau
country:Palau.text: Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island country located in the Micronesia subregion of Oceania in the western Pacific Ocean. The Republic of Palau consists of approximately 340 islands and is the western part of the Caroline Islands, while the eastern and central parts make up the Federated States of Micronesia.

country:Pakistan.title: Pakistan
country:Pakistan.text: Pakistan, officially the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, is a country in South Asia. It shares its border with other countries India, Iran, Afghanistan and China. Pakistan has the fifth largest population in the world and has a total land area of 880,940 km2 (340,130 sq mi).or in simple words 881,000 km² This makes Pakistan the 34th largest country in the world by land area.

country:Oman.title: Oman
country:Oman.text: Oman, officially the Sultanate of Oman, is a country in the southeastern Arabian Peninsula in West Asia. It shares land borders with Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Yemen, and maritime borders with Iran and Pakistan. Its coastline extends along the Arabian Sea to the southeast and the Gulf of Oman to the northeast.

country:Norway.title: Norway
country:Norway.text: Norway is a country in the north of Europe. It is the western part of the Scandinavian peninsula. The mainland of Norway is surrounded by the North Sea and Atlantic Ocean on the west side, and borders Russia, Finland, and Sweden to the east.

country:North Korea.title: North Korea
country:North Korea.text: North Korea, officially called the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) is a country in the northern part of the Korean peninsula in East Asia. North Korea is next to China, Russia, and South Korea. The capital city of North Korea is Pyongyang, which is also the largest city in the country.

country:Nigeria.title: Nigeria
country:Nigeria.text: Nigeria, officially Federal Republic of Nigeria, is a country in Africa.

country:Niger.title: Niger
country:Niger.text: Niger or the Niger, officially the Republic of the Niger, is a country in western Africa. The capital is Niamey, and the official language is Hausa. It is surrounded by Algeria and Libya to the north, Chad to the east, Nigeria and Benin to the south, and Burkina Faso and Mali to the west.

country:Nicaragua.title: Nicaragua
country:Nicaragua.text: Nicaragua, officially the Republic of Nicaragua, is a country in Central America. It borders, El Salvador, Honduras, and Costa Rica. To the south is the Pacific Ocean and to the north is Caribbean Sea.

country:New Zealand.title: New Zealand
country:New Zealand.text: New Zealand officially Commonwealth of New Zealand) is an island country in Oceania. It is a sovereign state in the south-western part of the Pacific Ocean. It is made up of two large islands and many smaller islands.

country:Niue.title: Niue
country:Niue.text: Niue is a sovereign island country in the south Pacific.

country:Cook Is..title: Cook Islands
country:Cook Is..text: The Cook Islands are a group of islands in the southern Pacific. They form an independent state, but have strong ties with New Zealand. The 15 small islands have a total land surface of 240 square kilometers.

country:Netherlands.title: Netherlands
country:Netherlands.text: The Netherlands is a country that is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Most of it is in Western Europe, but there are also some parts in the Caribbean. Nearly 18 million people live there.

country:Aruba.title: Aruba
country:Aruba.text: Aruba is an island in the Caribbean Sea, just north of the Venezuelan Paraguaná Peninsula. It is a country inside of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Unlike much of the Caribbean region, it has a dry climate and an arid, cactus-strewn landscape.

country:Curaçao.title: Curaçao
country:Curaçao.text: Curaçao is an island country in the Caribbean Sea. It is one of the ABC islands and is just a short distance north of the Venezuelan Paraguaná Peninsula, and it forms a part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Willemstad is the capital of Curaçao.

country:Nepal.title: Nepal
country:Nepal.text: Nepal, officially called the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, is a country in South Asia that doesn't border any ocean. It's mostly in the Himalayas, but also includes parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain. It's bordered by China to the north and India to the south, east, and west.

country:Nauru.title: Nauru
country:Nauru.text: Nauru,, officially the Republic of Naoero, is a island nation in the South Pacific. Its nearest neighbour is Kiribati, 300 kilometres (190 mi) east. Nauru is the smallest island nation, covering just 21 square kilometres (8 sq mi), the smallest republic, and the only republican state without a capital.

country:Namibia.title: Namibia
country:Namibia.text: The Republic of Namibia is a country in southern Africa on the Atlantic coast. It is bordered by the countries of Angola and Zambia to the north, Botswana to the east, and South Africa to the south. It does not border the country of Zimbabwe, but it is very close to it.

country:Mozambique.title: Mozambique
country:Mozambique.text: Mozambique, officially the Republic of Mozambique, is a country in southeastern Africa. Its capital is Maputo. There are about 31 million people.

country:Morocco.title: Morocco
country:Morocco.text: Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

country:W. Sahara.title: Western Sahara
country:W. Sahara.text: Western Sahara is a territory in north Africa. To the north is Morocco, to the east is Algeria, to the south is Mauritania, and to the west is the Atlantic Ocean. Its surface is 266,000 square kilometres (103,000 sq mi).

country:Montenegro.title: Montenegro
country:Montenegro.text: Montenegro (meaning Black Mountain) is a small country in Southeastern Europe. It is on the Adriatic Sea, between Albania and Croatia to the North. Inland it also has a common border with Serbia, and Bosnia and Herzegovina.

country:Mongolia.title: Mongolia
country:Mongolia.text: Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia. It has a border with Russia to the north and the People's Republic of China to the south and southeast. Mongolia's political system is a parliamentary republic.

country:Moldova.title: Moldova
country:Moldova.text: Moldova is a country in Eastern Europe. Its full name is the Republic of Moldova It used to be called Moldavia. It borders Ukraine to the east and Romania to the west.

country:Mexico.title: Mexico
country:Mexico.text: Mexico, officially the United Mexican States, is a country in North America. It borders the United States to the north, and Guatemala and Belize to the southeast; while having maritime boundaries with the Pacific Ocean to the west, the Caribbean Sea to the southeast, and the Gulf of Mexico to the east.

country:Mauritius.title: Mauritius
country:Mauritius.text: The Republic of Mauritius is an island nation in the Mascarene Islands. It includes Rodrigues, Agaléga and St. Brandon as well as Mauritius.

country:Mauritania.title: Mauritania
country:Mauritania.text: Mauritania is a country in northwest Africa. The capital city, which is also the biggest city in the country, is Nouakchott. It is on the Atlantic coast.

country:Malta.title: Malta
country:Malta.text: Malta is a country in Southern Europe, and a member of the European Union. It is an island near the center of the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily. Although it is geologically located on the African Plate, Malta is recognized as a European country.

country:Mali.title: Mali
country:Mali.text: Mali, officially the Republic of Mali ; Fula: 𞤈𞤫𞤲𞥆𞤣𞤢𞥄𞤲𞤣𞤭 𞤃𞤢𞥄𞤤𞤭, Arabic: جمهورية مالي) is a landlocked country in West Africa. Mali is bordered by Algeria on the North, Niger on the east, Burkina Faso and the Côte d'Ivoire on the south, Guinea on the south-west, and Senegal and Mauritania on the west.

country:Maldives.title: Maldives
country:Maldives.text: The Maldives are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean. They are southwest of India. They are made up of the Maldive and Suadive archipelagos, with over 1,200 islands.

country:Malaysia.title: Malaysia
country:Malaysia.text: Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia. The federal constitutional monarchy consists of thirteen states and three federal territories, separated by the South China Sea into two regions, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo's East Malaysia. Peninsular Malaysia shares a land and maritime border with Thailand and maritime borders with Singapore, Vietnam, and Indonesia.

country:Malawi.title: Malawi
country:Malawi.text: Malawi is a country in south-east Africa. It has borders with the countries of Tanzania, Zambia, and Mozambique. The capital of Malawi is Lilongwe and the spoken languages are English and Chichewa.

country:Madagascar.title: Madagascar
country:Madagascar.text: Madagascar is a large island nation in the Indian Ocean. It is off of the East coast of Africa and its capital is Antananarivo. Twenty-two million people live there.

country:North Macedonia.title: North Macedonia
country:North Macedonia.text: North Macedonia, is a country located on the Balkan peninsula in Southeastern Europe.

country:Luxembourg.title: Luxembourg
country:Luxembourg.text: Luxembourg (officially called the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg is a landlocked country in Western Europe.

country:Lithuania.title: Lithuania
country:Lithuania.text: Lithuania is a country in Europe. It borders Latvia to the north, Belarus to the southeast, Poland to the south and Russia to the southwest. It is one of the Baltic states.

country:Liechtenstein.title: Liechtenstein
country:Liechtenstein.text: Liechtenstein, officially the Principality of Liechtenstein, is a small country in the middle of Europe. It is a landlocked country, meaning it has no coastline. Liechtenstein is situated between Switzerland and Austria, high up in the Alps.

country:Libya.title: Libya
country:Libya.text: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in North Africa. It is bordered by the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Egypt to the east, Sudan to the southeast, Chad and Niger to the south, and Algeria and Tunisia to the west. It covers an area of almost 1.8 million square kilometres (700,000 sq mi).

country:Liberia.title: Liberia
country:Liberia.text: The Republic of Liberia is a small country on the coast of West Africa. It has common borders with Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Ivory Coast. The country has a size of about 520 kilometres (320 mi) by 270 kilometres (170 mi).

country:Lesotho.title: Lesotho
country:Lesotho.text: Lesotho is a small country in southern Africa. It is entirely surrounded by South Africa. Its population is about 1,800,000.

country:Lebanon.title: Lebanon
country:Lebanon.text: Lebanon is a country in the Middle East, in Western Asia, next to the Mediterranean Sea. It has borders with Israel to the south and Syria to the east and north. It also shares a maritime border with Cyprus to the northwest, away from the country's short distance.

country:Latvia.title: Latvia
country:Latvia.text: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in Northern Europe. The capital is Riga. It is one of the Baltic states, together with Estonia in the north and Lithuania in the south.

country:Laos.title: Laos
country:Laos.text: Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Southeast Asia.[4]

country:Kyrgyzstan.title: Kyrgyzstan
country:Kyrgyzstan.text: {{Infobox country | conventional_long_name = Kyrgyz Republic | common_name = Kyrgyzstan

country:Kuwait.title: Kuwait
country:Kuwait.text: Kuwait is a small Arab country in the Middle East.

country:Kosovo.title: Kosovo
country:Kosovo.text: Kosovo, is a partially recognised country located in Southeastern Europe. Until 2008, Kosovo was a part of Serbia. On 17 February 2008, Kosovo declared independence and said it was now a separate country.

country:Kiribati.title: Kiribati
country:Kiribati.text: Kiribati is an island country in the Pacific Ocean. It has 33 atolls, groups of tiny islands. The country is near the equator.

country:Kenya.title: Kenya
country:Kenya.text: Kenya is a country in East Africa, about halfway down the continent, near the Horn of Africa. It is about the size of France, and almost as large as the U.S. state of Texas.

country:Kazakhstan.title: Kazakhstan
country:Kazakhstan.text: Kazakhstan is a landlocked country in the middle of Eurasia. Its official name is the Republic of Kazakhstan. Kazakhstan is the ninth biggest country in the world, and it is also the biggest landlocked country in the world.

country:Jordan.title: Jordan
country:Jordan.text: Jordan is an Arab country in southwest Asia, in the Middle East, in the southern part of the Levant region, and the northern part of the Arabian Peninsula. Jordan has borders with Syria to the north, Palestine and Israel to the west, Iraq to the east, Saudi Arabia to the east and south, and the Gulf of Aqaba to the southwest, where the city of Aqaba is next to the Red Sea.

country:Japan.title: Japan
country:Japan.text: Japan is a country in East Asia. It is a group of islands close to the east coast of Korea, China and Russia. The Pacific Ocean is to the east of Japan and the Sea of Japan is to the west.

country:Jamaica.title: Jamaica
country:Jamaica.text: Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean; it is part of the Greater Antilles. The island, 10,990 square kilometres (4,240 sq mi) in area, lies about 140 kilometres (87 mi) south of Cuba, and 191 kilometres (119 mi) west of Hispaniola. Its capital city is Kingston; other towns include Montego Bay, St.

country:Italy.title: Italy
country:Italy.text: Italy is a country in Southern Europe with small island territories in North Africa. It is a founding member of the European Union and a member of the G7 and G20, as it has the eighth largest gross domestic product in the world. Italy's official name is the Italian Republic.

country:Israel.title: Israel
country:Israel.text: Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in southwestern Asia on the eastern side of the Mediterranean Sea. Its capital city is Jerusalem.

country:Palestine.title: Palestine (region)
country:Palestine.text: Palestine is a region in the Middle East. It is in the Levant, between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea. Many cultures have lived in Palestine through history and built their civilizations, such as the Philistines, Phoenicians and Arabs.

country:Ireland.title: Republic of Ireland
country:Ireland.text: Ireland ) is a European country on the island of Ireland. It shares a border with Northern Ireland. The country is sometimes called the Republic of Ireland to distinguish it from the island.

country:Iraq.title: Iraq
country:Iraq.text: Iraq is a country in southwestern Asia. Iraq borders Saudi Arabia and Kuwait to the south, Turkey to the north, Syria to the northwest, Jordan to the west, and Iran to the east. The capital of Iraq is Baghdad.

country:Iran.title: Iran
country:Iran.text: Iran, officially the Islamic Republic of Iran and also known as Persia, is a country in Western Asia. Prior to 1935, the country was referred to by majority in the Western world as Persia. Iran is quite significant due to its ancient history and its positioning between the Middle East, Central Asia, and South Asia.

country:Indonesia.title: Indonesia
country:Indonesia.text: Indonesia, officially the Republic of Indonesia; Nusantara) is a nation in Southeast Asia and Oceania. As the biggest archipelago country in the world, Indonesia has 17,504 islands. The most important islands of Indonesia are Java, Bali, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, and Sumatra.

country:India.title: India
country:India.text: India, officially the Republic of India, also known as Hindustān, is a country in South Asia. It is the world's seventh-largest country by area. It is also the most populated country in the world.

country:Iceland.title: Iceland
country:Iceland.text: Iceland ) is an island country between the North Atlantic and Arctic, between Greenland and Norway. It is culturally considered to be part of Europe. Iceland is 301 kilometers east of Greenland and 1001 kilometers west of Norway.

country:Hungary.title: Hungary
country:Hungary.text: Hungary ) is a landlocked country in Southeastern Central Europe. It is bordered by Slovakia to the North, Ukraine to the Northeast, Romania to the East and southeast, Serbia to the South, Croatia and Slovenia to the Southwest, and Austria to the west. Hungary lies within the drainage basin of the Danube River and is dominated by great lowland plains.

country:Honduras.title: Honduras
country:Honduras.text: Honduras, officially the Republic of Honduras, is a country in Central America. It borders Guatemala, El Salvador and Nicaragua. To the south is the Pacific Ocean, Gulf of Fonseca, and to the north is Gulf of Honduras.

country:Haiti.title: Haiti
country:Haiti.text: Haiti, officially the Republic of Haiti is a country on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola. The other country on the island is the Dominican Republic. Haiti has two official languages: French and Haitian Creole, or "Kreyol", which is a simple version of French mixed with African languages.

country:Guyana.title: Guyana
country:Guyana.text: The Co-operative Republic of Guyana is a country in South America. It is one of the most sparsely populated countries in the world. Georgetown is the capital; like most of the country's settlements, it is on a flat coastal plain that goes from northwest to southeast.

country:Guinea-Bissau.title: Guinea-Bissau
country:Guinea-Bissau.text: Guinea-Bissau is a country in Africa. It borders Senegal to the north, Guinea to the south. The official language is Portuguese, and the capital is Bissau.

country:Guinea.title: Guinea
country:Guinea.text: Guinea, or the Republic of Guinea, is an independent nation in Western Africa. Guinea borders 6 countries: Guinea-Bissau, Senegal, Mali, Ivory Coast, Liberia, Sierra Leone. The national language is French.

country:Guatemala.title: Guatemala
country:Guatemala.text: Guatemala, officially the Republic of Guatemala, is a country in Central America. It borders Mexico, Belize, Honduras, and El Salvador. To the northeast is the Caribbean Sea and Gulf of Honduras and its capital and largest city is Guatemala City.

country:Grenada.title: Grenada
country:Grenada.text: Grenada is an island country in the Caribbean Sea that received its independence from the United Kingdom in 1974. Its capital is St. George's.

country:Greece.title: Greece
country:Greece.text: Greece, officially the Hellenic Republic, historically known as Hellas (Ελλάς), is a country mostly located in Southeastern Europe with small island territories in Asia. Its capital city is Athens.

country:Ghana.title: Ghana
country:Ghana.text: Ghana, officially the Republic of Ghana, is a country in West Africa. It is situated with the Gulf of Guinea and the Atlantic Ocean to the south, and shares borders with Ivory Coast to the west, Burkina Faso to the north, and Togo to the east. Ghana covers an area of 239,567 km2 (92,497 sq mi), spanning various ecologies, from coastal savannas to tropical rainforests.

country:Germany.title: Germany
country:Germany.text: Germany is a country in the western region of Central Europe. The country's full name is sometimes shortened to the FRG.

country:Gambia.title: The Gambia
country:Gambia.text: The Gambia, officially the Republic of The Gambia, is a country in West Africa. Geographically, the Gambia is the smallest country in continental Africa; it is bounded by Senegal on all sides except for the western part, which is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean.

country:Gabon.title: Gabon
country:Gabon.text: Gabon, officially the Gabonese Republic, is a country on the Atlantic coast of Central Africa, lying on the equator. It is bordered by Equatorial Guinea to the northwest, Cameroon to the north, the Republic of the Congo to the east and south, while sharing a maritime border with São Tomé and Príncipe to the west in the Gulf of Guinea.

country:France.title: France
country:France.text: France, officially the French Republic, is a country primarily located in Western Europe. Its overseas regions and territories include French Guiana in South America, Saint Pierre and Miquelon in the North Atlantic, the French West Indies, and many islands in Oceania and the Indian Ocean.

country:New Caledonia.title: New Caledonia
country:New Caledonia.text: New Caledonia is a "sui generis collectivity" of France, made up of a main island and several smaller islands. It is in the region of Melanesia in the southwest Pacific. At about half the size of Taiwan, it has a land area of 18,575.5 square kilometres (7,172 sq mi).

country:Åland.title: Åland Islands
country:Åland.text: The Åland Islands form an archipelago in the Baltic Sea. It is at the entrance to the Gulf of Bothnia and forms an autonomous, demilitarized, monolingually Swedish-speaking administrative province, region and historical province of Finland. It is the smallest province of Finland, with 0.5% of Finland's population and 0.49% of the land area.

country:Finland.title: Finland
country:Finland.text: Finland is a country in Northern Europe and is a member state of the European Union and NATO. Finland is one of the Nordic countries and is also part of Fennoscandia. Finland is located between the 60th and 70th latitudes North.

country:Fiji.title: Fiji
country:Fiji.text: Fiji is an island country in the Pacific Ocean. It has 322 islands. The most important islands are Vanua Levu and Viti Levu.

country:Ethiopia.title: Ethiopia
country:Ethiopia.text: Ethiopia has one of the longest known histories as a country in Africa. Ethiopia was one of the few countries in Africa that escaped the Scramble for Africa. It avoided being colonized until 1935, when it was invaded by the Italians under Benito Mussolini, who took over the country for a brief time.

country:Estonia.title: Estonia
country:Estonia.text: Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia is a country by the Baltic Sea in Northern Europe. The capital city is Tallinn. Estonia has borders with Sweden, Finland, Russia and Latvia.

country:Eritrea.title: Eritrea
country:Eritrea.text: Eritrea is a country on the eastern coast of Africa. Its official name is The State of Eritrea.

country:Eq. Guinea.title: Equatorial Guinea
country:Eq. Guinea.text: Equatorial Guinea, officially the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, is a country on the west coast of Central Africa and the only Spanish-speaking country in Africa. It has an area of 28,000 square kilometres (11,000 sq mi). Formerly the colony of Spanish Guinea, its post-independence name refers to its location both near the Equator and in the African region of Guinea.

country:El Salvador.title: El Salvador
country:El Salvador.text: El Salvador, officially the Republic of El Salvador, is a country in Central America. It borders Honduras and Guatemala. To the south by the Pacific Ocean and its capital and largest city is San Salvador.

country:Egypt.title: Egypt
country:Egypt.text: Egypt, officially the Arab Republic of Egypt, is a country in the Middle East and the Eastern Mediterranean, located in North Africa and Western Asia.

country:Ecuador.title: Ecuador
country:Ecuador.text: Ecuador is a small country in South America. It used to be part of the Spanish Empire and Gran Colombia. Spain was interested in finding gold in Ecuador.

country:Dominican Rep..title: Dominican Republic
country:Dominican Rep..text: The Dominican Republic is an island country on the eastern part of the Caribbean island of Hispaniola in the Greater Antilles of the Caribbean Sea in the North Atlantic Ocean.

country:Dominica.title: Dominica
country:Dominica.text: The Commonwealth of Dominica is an island nation in the Caribbean Sea. It is an English-speaking country. It is between the French-speaking territories of Guadeloupe and Martinique.

country:Djibouti.title: Djibouti
country:Djibouti.text: Djibouti is a country on the eastern coast of Africa. The capital city is also called Djibouti.

country:Greenland.title: Greenland
country:Greenland.text: Greenland is the world's largest island. Greenland is a self-governing territory of the kingdom of Denmark. This large Arctic island is near two countries, Iceland to the east and Canada to the west.

country:Denmark.title: Denmark
country:Denmark.text: Denmark, officially named the Kingdom of Denmark, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe. It is the furthest south of the Scandinavian countries, to the northeast of North America, to the south of Norway and south-west of Sweden. It has a south border with Germany and a northeast border with Canada.

country:Czechia.title: Czech Republic
country:Czechia.text: The Czech Republic, otherwise referred to as Czechia, is a country in Central Europe. The capital and biggest city is Prague. The currency is the Czech Crown.

country:Cyprus.title: Cyprus
country:Cyprus.text: Cyprus is an island country in the Mediterranean Sea. Cyprus is in Asia, along with being apart of the Middle East and the Levant. The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC), a de facto state only recognized by Turkey is situated in the north of the island.

country:Cuba.title: Cuba
country:Cuba.text: Cuba is an island country in the Caribbean Sea. The country is made up of the big island of Cuba, the Isla de la Juventud island, and many smaller islands. Havana is the capital city of Cuba.

country:Croatia.title: Croatia
country:Croatia.text: Croatia is a unitary democratic parliamentary republic in Central and Southeastern Europe. Croatia has been influenced by powers from both regions at varying points in its history. Its capital and largest city is Zagreb.

country:Côte d'Ivoire.title: Ivory Coast
country:Côte d'Ivoire.text: Ivory Coast or Côte d'Ivoire, officially the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, is a country in West Africa.

country:Costa Rica.title: Costa Rica
country:Costa Rica.text: Costa Rica, officially the Republic of Costa Rica, is a country in Central America. It borders Nicaragua and Panama. To the northeast is the Caribbean Sea and to the southwest is the Pacific Ocean.

country:Dem. Rep. Congo.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo
country:Dem. Rep. Congo.text: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), also known as the DR Congo, Congo-Kinshasa, or simply the Congo, and formerly named Zaire, is a country in Central Africa. By land area, it is the second-largest country in Africa and the eleventh-largest in the world.

country:Comoros.title: Comoros
country:Comoros.text: Comoros is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean. It is between Madagascar and mainland Africa. The capital is Moroni on Grande Comore.

country:Colombia.title: Colombia
country:Colombia.text: Colombia officially the Republic of Colombia, is a tropical equatorial country in northern South America. It is in the northwest part of the continent, and it has an area of 1 141 748 km2.

country:China.title: China
country:China.text: China is a country, cultural region, and ancient civilization located in East Asia. Covering an immense geographic area, China features a diverse landscape ranging from arid deserts in the north to tropical forests in the south, bounded by the Pacific Ocean to the east and the Himalayan mountain range to the west.

country:Macao.title: Macau
country:Macao.text: Macau or Macao is a special administrative region of China. It consists of the Macau Peninsula, the islands of Taipa and Coloane, the Cotai reclamation zone between Taipa and Coloane, and several smaller islets. It borders Zhuhai to the north and west, and it lies west of Hong Kong, separated by the Pearl River estuary.

country:Hong Kong.title: Hong Kong
country:Hong Kong.text: Hong Kong is a special administrative region of China. Situated on China's southern coast just south of Shenzhen, it consists of Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, and the New Territories. With 7.5 million residents in a 1,114-square-kilometre (430 sq mi) territory, Hong Kong is the fourth-most densely populated region in the world.

country:Chile.title: Chile
country:Chile.text: Chile, officially the Republic of Chile, is a country on the south-western side of South America. Most people there speak Spanish.

country:Chad.title: Chad
country:Chad.text: Chad, is a landlocked country in Central Africa. The capital is N'Djamena.

country:Cabo Verde.title: Cape Verde
country:Cabo Verde.text: Cape Verde or Cabo Verde, officially the Republic of Cabo Verde, is an island country in Africa. It is a group of islands in the Atlantic Ocean, 570 km (354 mi) off the coast of Western Africa. The islands cover a combined area of slightly over 4,000 km2 (1,500 sq mi).

country:Canada.title: Canada
country:Canada.text: Canada is a country in North America. Its land reaches from the Atlantic Ocean to the east to the Pacific Ocean to the west. The Arctic Ocean is to the north of Canada.

country:Cameroon.title: Cameroon
country:Cameroon.text: Cameroon, officially the Republic of Cameroon, is a country in Central Africa. It shares boundaries with Nigeria to the west and north, Chad to the northeast, the Central African Republic to the east, and Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, and the Republic of the Congo to the south. Its coastline lies on the Bight of Biafra, part of the Gulf of Guinea, and the Atlantic Ocean.

country:Cambodia.title: Cambodia
country:Cambodia.text: Cambodia, officially the Kingdom of Cambodia, is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Thailand to the northwest, Laos to the north, and Vietnam to the east, and has a coastline along the Gulf of Thailand in the southwest. It spans an area of about 181,035 km2 (69,898 sq mi), dominated by a low-lying plain and the confluence of the Mekong river and Tonlé Sap, Southeast Asia's largest lake.

country:Myanmar.title: Myanmar
country:Myanmar.text: Myanmar, formerly and occasionally called Burma in English, is a country in Southeast Asia. Its full name is the Republic of the Union of Myanmar. Myanmar is the largest country in Southeast Asia that is not an island country.

country:Burundi.title: Burundi
country:Burundi.text: Burundi, officially the Republic of Burundi, is a landlocked country in East Africa. It is located in the Great Rift Valley at the junction between the African Great Lakes region and southeastern Africa, with a population of over 14 million people. It is bordered by Rwanda to the north, Tanzania to the east and southeast, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the west; Lake Tanganyika lies along its southwestern border.

country:Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso
country:Burkina Faso.text: Burkina Faso is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is bordered by Mali to the northwest, Niger to the northeast, Benin to the southeast, Togo and Ghana to the south, and Ivory Coast to the southwest. It covers an area of 274,223 km2 (105,878 sq mi).

country:Bulgaria.title: Bulgaria
country:Bulgaria.text: Bulgaria, officially the Republic of Bulgaria, is a country in Southeastern Europe. It is situated on the eastern portion of the Balkans directly south of the Danube river and west of the Black Sea. Bulgaria is bordered by Greece and Turkey to the south, Serbia and North Macedonia to the west, and Romania across the Danube river to the north.

country:Brunei.title: Brunei
country:Brunei.text: Brunei, officially Brunei Darussalam, is a country in Southeast Asia, situated on the northern coast of the island of Borneo. Apart from its coastline on the South China Sea, it is completely surrounded by the Malaysian state of Sarawak, with its territory bifurcated by the Sarawak district of Limbang.

country:Brazil.title: Brazil
country:Brazil.text: Brazil, officially the Federative Republic of Brazil, is a country in South America. It is the world's fifth-largest country by area, behind Russia, Canada, the United States, and China, with a total area of 8,514,877 square kilometers (3,287,612 sq mi). It is also the world's seventh-largest country by population, with about 212 million people.

country:Botswana.title: Botswana
country:Botswana.text: Botswana, officially the Republic of Botswana, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa. Botswana is topographically flat, with approximately 70% of its territory being a part of the Kalahari Desert. It is bordered by South Africa to the south and southeast, Namibia to the west and north, Zambia to the north, and Zimbabwe to the northeast.

country:Bolivia.title: Bolivia
country:Bolivia.text: Bolivia, officially the Plurinational State of Bolivia, is a country in South America. It is landlocked by Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, Peru, and Chile. Rodrigo Paz Pereira became its president in November 2025.

country:Bhutan.title: Bhutan
country:Bhutan.text: Bhutan is a small landlocked country in the Himalaya mountains of South Asia. It is ruled by King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, who has been king since 2006. Bhutan was founded in 1644 by Shabdrung Ngawang Namgyel.

country:Benin.title: Benin
country:Benin.text: Benin is a country in Africa. The capital of Benin is Porto-Novo. The government is based in Cotonou, the country's largest city.

country:Belize.title: Belize
country:Belize.text: Belize is a country in Central America. It used to be called British Honduras, but changed its name in 1973. Long before that it was part of the Mayan Empire.

country:Belgium.title: Belgium
country:Belgium.text: Belgium is a country in Western Europe. Its capital, Brussels, is the home of many organizations, including the European Union and NATO. Belgium is bordered by the Netherlands in the north, Germany to the east, Luxembourg to the southeast and France to the south.

country:Belarus.title: Belarus
country:Belarus.text: Belarus is a country in Eastern Europe. About nine million people live there. Its capital is Minsk. It was part of the Soviet Union until 1991.

country:Barbados.title: Barbados
country:Barbados.text: Barbados is an island country in the Atlantic Ocean. The island has an area of about 430 km². Its capital and largest city is Bridgetown.

country:Bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
country:Bangladesh.text: Bangladesh, officially called the People's Republic of Bangladesh, is a country in South Asia. It is the eighth most populated country in the world and one of the most tightly packed, with more than 170 million people living in an area of 148,460 square kilometres (57,320 sq mi). Bangladesh has land borders with India on the north, west, and east, and Myanmar on the southeast.

country:Bahrain.title: Bahrain
country:Bahrain.text: Bahrain is an island country in the Persian Gulf. Saudi Arabia is to the west and is connected to Bahrain by the King Fahd Causeway, and Qatar is to the south across the Persian Gulf. The Qatar-Bahrain Friendship Bridge, not yet built, will link Bahrain to Qatar as the longest fixed bridge in the world.

country:Bahamas.title: The Bahamas
country:Bahamas.text: The Bahamas are a group of islands in the Caribbean Sea. The country's capital, Nassau, is on New Providence Island.

country:Azerbaijan.title: Azerbaijan
country:Azerbaijan.text: Azerbaijan is a country in the South Caucasus region of Eurasia. It borders on Russia in the north, Georgia and, Armenia in the west, Iran in the south, and the Caspian Sea on the east. Its capital city is Baku.

country:Austria.title: Austria
country:Austria.text: Austria ), officially the Republic of Austria ), is a country in Central Europe. Around Austria are the countries of Germany, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Italy, Switzerland, and Liechtenstein.

country:Australia.title: Australia
country:Australia.text: Australia, officially the Commonwealth of Australia, is an island country and sovereign state located in the southern hemisphere, in Oceania. Its capital city is Canberra, and its largest city is Sydney. It is mostly a desert country.

country:Norfolk Island.title: Norfolk Island
country:Norfolk Island.text: Norfolk Island is a territory of Australia. It is in the South Pacific Ocean between Australia, New Zealand, and New Caledonia. It was one of the first British settlements in the Pacific.

country:Armenia.title: Armenia
country:Armenia.text: Armenia, officially the Republic of Armenia, is a landlocked country located in the Armenian Highlands in the Caucasus region of Eastern Europe and Western Asia.

country:Argentina.title: Argentina
country:Argentina.text: Argentina, officially the Argentine Republic, is a country in South America. Argentina is the second-largest country in South America and the eighth-largest country in the world.

country:Angola.title: Angola
country:Angola.text: Angola, officially the Republic of Angola, is a country in southern Africa. It shares borders with Namibia in the south, the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the north, and Zambia in the east. Its west border touches the Atlantic Ocean.

country:Andorra.title: Andorra
country:Andorra.text: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked sovereign country located in the eastern Pyrenees Mountains of Southern Europe and bordered by Spain and France.

country:Algeria.title: Algeria
country:Algeria.text: Algeria, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria is a North African country. It is the second biggest nation in Africa and the 10th largest world over in terms of total land area. It is situated along the Mediterranean Sea with its borders being Tunisia, Libya, Niger, Mali, Mauritania, Western Sahara and Morocco.

country:Albania.title: Albania
country:Albania.text: Albania, officially called the Republic of Albania is an independent country located in Southeast Europe, more specifically it is located in the Balkans. The capital is Tirana, and other important cities are Durrës, Elbasan and Vlora. Over 3 million people live in the area of 28,748 square kilometres (11,100 sq mi) that Albanians call their home.

country:Afghanistan.title: Afghanistan
country:Afghanistan.text: Afghanistan, officially the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan is a country in Asia. It borders Pakistan in the south and east, Iran in the west, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan and Tajikistan in the north, and China in the far northeast. Kabul is the capital city.

country:Siachen Glacier.title: Siachen Glacier
country:Siachen Glacier.text: The Siachen Glacier is in the eastern Karakoram range in the Himalaya Mountains along the disputed India-Pakistan interim border at approximately 35.5°N 77.0°E. Siachen Glacier was the Land of Wild Roses before it became a battle field. It is the longest glacier in the Karakoram and second longest in the world's non-polar areas.

country:Antarctica.title: Antarctica
country:Antarctica.text: Antarctica is the Earth's southernmost and the continent with the least people. It is on the South Pole. It is almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle.

state:Western Australia.title: Western Australia
state:Western Australia.text: Western Australia is one of the eight states and territories of Australia. It is the largest state in Australia, with about 33% of the land area of the mainland. It has a population of nearly three million people.

state:Northern Territory.title: Northern Territory
state:Northern Territory.text: The Northern Territory is a territory of Australia. The capital city is Darwin. Other large towns in the Territory include Alice Springs, Katherine and Tennant Creek.

state:South Australia.title: South Australia
state:South Australia.text: South Australia is one of the six states of Australia. The capital city is Adelaide.

state:Queensland.title: Queensland
state:Queensland.text: Queensland is a state in eastern Australia. It is the second largest state by area and the third largest state by population. In 2006 there were 3,904,532 people living in Queensland.

state:Tasmania.title: Tasmania
state:Tasmania.text: Tasmania is a large island off the southern coast of mainland Australia. It is a state of Australia. Its capital and the largest city is Hobart.

state:Australian Capital Territory.title: Australian Capital Territory
state:Australian Capital Territory.text: The Australian Capital Territory or ACT is a small territory in Australia. It was created as the home for the Australian capital city, Canberra, because of fighting between New South Wales and Victoria over where the capital city should be. The Jervis Bay Territory was created at the same time so that the ACT would have a harbour without relying on one of the states.

state:Jervis Bay Territory.title: Jervis Bay Territory
state:Jervis Bay Territory.text: The Jervis Bay Territory is a territory of Australia. It was bought from New South Wales in 1915, to give the Australian Capital Territory (ACT) access to the sea. In 1989 it was separated from the ACT.

state:New South Wales.title: New South Wales
state:New South Wales.text: New South Wales is one of the states of Australia. It is the oldest state in Australia and is sometimes called the "Premier State". Of all Australian states, New South Wales has the most people.

state:Alberta.title: Alberta
state:Alberta.text: Alberta is a province in western Canada. It is bounded by the provinces of British Columbia on the west, Saskatchewan on the east, the US state of Montana on the south and the Northwest Territories to the north.

state:British Columbia.title: British Columbia
state:British Columbia.text: British Columbia (BC) is a province in Canada. It was originally two separate colonies of Great Britain, the colony of Vancouver Island, and the colony of British Columbia. British Columbia joined the Canadian Confederation in 1871.

state:Manitoba.title: Manitoba
state:Manitoba.text: Manitoba is a province of Canada that is located roughly in the centre of the country.

state:New Brunswick.title: New Brunswick
state:New Brunswick.text: New Brunswick is a province in the eastern part of Canada. The capital city of New Brunswick is Fredericton. Other large cities are Saint John and Moncton.

state:Newfoundland and Labrador.title: Newfoundland and Labrador
state:Newfoundland and Labrador.text: Newfoundland and Labrador is a province on the East Coast of Canada, and is the farthest east of all Canadian provinces and territories. The capital of Newfoundland and Labrador is St. John's.

state:Nova Scotia.title: Nova Scotia
state:Nova Scotia.text: Nova Scotia ; French pronunciation: ) is a small province found on the east coast of Canada. The name "Nova Scotia" is Latin for "New Scotland". The capital and largest city is Halifax.

state:Northwest Territories.title: Northwest Territories
state:Northwest Territories.text: The Northwest Territories is a territory in Northern Canada. 45,904 people live there as of 2026. It is 1,171,918 square kilometers.

state:Nunavut.title: Nunavut
state:Nunavut.text: Nunavut is a territory in Canada. It is the newest, largest, and northernmost territory of Canada. It was founded on April 1, 1999 when many Inuit living in the Northwest Territories wanted to have an independent province and government.

state:Ontario.title: Ontario
state:Ontario.text: Ontario is a province of Canada that is in the eastern half of Canada, between Manitoba and Quebec. Ontario has the largest population of any province, with over 16 million in 2026, and is home to the largest city in Canada, Toronto, which is also the capital of the province.

state:Prince Edward Island.title: Prince Edward Island
state:Prince Edward Island.text: Prince Edward Island is a province of Canada. It is the smallest of Canada's ten provinces. Most of the people on Prince Edward Island speak English.

state:Québec.title: Quebec
state:Québec.text: Quebec ) is a province in the eastern part of Canada located between the Hudson Bay and the Gulf of Saint Lawrence. It is the biggest of Canada's 10 provinces by size. It also has the second-largest population, after Ontario.

state:Saskatchewan.title: Saskatchewan
state:Saskatchewan.text: Saskatchewan is a province in Canada. About 1.25 million people live in Saskatchewan. Most of its population lives in the southern part of the province.

state:Yukon.title: Yukon
state:Yukon.text: The Yukon is a territory of Canada, north of British Columbia, west of the Northwest Territories, and east of the American state of Alaska. Its population is around 50,000. Most of the territory's people live in the capital of Whitehorse.

state:Alaska.title: Alaska
state:Alaska.text: Alaska, officially the State of Alaska, is a state in the United States. It is in the northwest corner of North America near Asia (Russia), making it the nearest U.S. state and overall country's jurisdiction to Asian continent.

state:Alabama.title: Alabama
state:Alabama.text: Alabama ( ) is a state in the United States. Its capital city is Montgomery. The largest city is Huntsville. It became a state in 1819.

state:Arkansas.title: Arkansas
state:Arkansas.text: Arkansas is a state in the United States of America. Its capital and largest city is Little Rock. It is considered part of the South, and is bordered by Oklahoma to the west, Missouri to the north, Tennessee and Mississippi to the east, Louisiana to the south, and its southwestern corner touches Texas.

state:Arizona.title: Arizona
state:Arizona.text: Arizona is a state in the United States of America. It is considered part of the Southwestern United States and is bordered by New Mexico to the east, Utah to the north, Nevada to the northwest, California to the west, its northeast corner touches part of Colorado, this area is known as the Four Corners. To the south of Arizona is the country Mexico with which it shares a border of 389 miles (626 km).

state:California.title: California
state:California.text: California, officially the State of California, is a state in the western part of the United States, along the Pacific Ocean.

state:Colorado.title: Colorado
state:Colorado.text: Colorado is a state in the western United States. Its capital and largest city is Denver. Other large cities are Colorado Springs and Aurora.

state:Connecticut.title: Connecticut
state:Connecticut.text: Connecticut is a state in the United States. Its capital is Hartford, and its largest city is Bridgeport. It is one of the six states of New England.

state:District of Columbia.title: Washington, D.C.
state:District of Columbia.text: Washington, D.C. is the capital city of the United States of America. It is a federal district. The President of the United States, the United States Congress, the United States Supreme Court and many major national government offices are in the territory.

state:Delaware.title: Delaware
state:Delaware.text: Delaware is a state in the United States. It is sometimes called the First State because it was the first colony to accept the new constitution in 1787. Its capital is Dover and its biggest city is Wilmington.

state:Florida.title: Florida
state:Florida.text: Florida, is a state in the southeast part of the United States. It is the 22nd largest US state by total area with 65,757.70 sq mi and the third most-populous with a 2020 population of more than 21 million. It is a peninsula, which means that water surrounds the state on three of four possible sides.

state:Hawaii.title: Hawaii
state:Hawaii.text: Hawaii is a U.S. state and the only U.S. State that is in Oceania, about 1,700 nautical miles southwest of the U.S. mainland.

state:Iowa.title: Iowa
state:Iowa.text: Iowa is a state in the Midwestern United States. Its name comes from the Iowa River, which was named after the Ioway people, a Native American tribe that lived in Iowa. Iowa was a part of New France, but was sold to the United States as part of the Louisiana Purchase.

state:Idaho.title: Idaho
state:Idaho.text: Idaho is a state in the northwestern United States, and was the 43rd state to join the union.

state:Illinois.title: Illinois
state:Illinois.text: Illinois is a state in the United States. Its capital is Springfield and its largest city is Chicago. It is bordered to the north by Wisconsin, to the west by Iowa and below that, by Missouri.

state:Indiana.title: Indiana
state:Indiana.text: Indiana is a U.S. state in the midwestern and Great Lakes regions of North America. Its capital and largest city is Indianapolis.

state:Kansas.title: Kansas
state:Kansas.text: Kansas is a state in the Midwestern United States. The name of the state comes from the Kansa Native Americans, whose name comes from a Siouan-language phrase meaning "people of the south wind". The land that would become Kansas was bought in the Louisiana Purchase in 1803.

state:Kentucky.title: Kentucky
state:Kentucky.text: Kentucky is a state in the United States. Its capital is Frankfort. It touches the states of Missouri, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, West Virginia, Tennessee and Virginia.

state:Louisiana.title: Louisiana
state:Louisiana.text: Louisiana is a state in the Deep South and South Central regions of the United States. It is bordered by Texas to the west, Arkansas to the north, and Mississippi to the east. Of the 50 U.S.

state:Massachusetts.title: Massachusetts
state:Massachusetts.text: Massachusetts is a state in the United States of America. Its official name is the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

state:Maryland.title: Maryland
state:Maryland.text: Maryland is a state in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern regions of the United States. It borders Virginia to its south, West Virginia to its west, Pennsylvania to its north, and Delaware to its east, as well as with the Atlantic Ocean to its east, and the national capital and federal district of Washington, D.C. to the southwest.

state:Maine.title: Maine
state:Maine.text: Maine is the northeast-most state in the United States. The capital is Augusta, although the city of Portland, farther south, is the largest in the state. Maine became the 23rd state, on March 15, 1820.

state:Michigan.title: Michigan
state:Michigan.text: Michigan is one of the fifty states in the United States of America. It is the 11th largest state in the United States. It is made up of two peninsulas, the only state to be so.

state:Minnesota.title: Minnesota
state:Minnesota.text: Minnesota is a state in the Upper Midwestern region of the United States. It is bordered by the Canadian provinces of Manitoba and Ontario to the north and east and by the U.S. states of Wisconsin to the east, Iowa to the south, and North Dakota and South Dakota to the west.

state:Missouri.title: Missouri
state:Missouri.text: Missouri is one of the 50 states in the United States. Its capital is Jefferson City. Its largest cities are Kansas City and Saint Louis.

state:Mississippi.title: Mississippi
state:Mississippi.text: Mississippi is one of the states of the Southern United States. Its capital and largest city is Jackson. The state flower and tree are the magnolia.

state:Montana.title: Montana
state:Montana.text: Montana is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is bordered by Idaho to the west, North Dakota to the east, South Dakota to the southeast, Wyoming to the south, and the Canadian provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan to the north. It is the fourth-largest state by area, but the eighth-least populous state and the third-least densely populated state.

state:North Carolina.title: North Carolina
state:North Carolina.text: North Carolina is a state in the Southeastern and South Atlantic regions of the United States. It is bordered by Virginia to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the east, South Carolina to the south, Georgia to the southwest, and Tennessee to the west. The state is the 28th-largest and ninth-most populous of the United States.

state:Nebraska.title: Nebraska
state:Nebraska.text: Nebraska is a landlocked state in the Great Plains and Midwestern region of the United States. It borders South Dakota to the north; Wyoming to the west; Colorado to the southwest; Kansas to the south; and Missouri to the southeast and Iowa to the east, both across the Missouri River. Nebraska is the 16th-largest state by land area, with just over 77,347 square miles (200,330 km2).

state:New Hampshire.title: New Hampshire
state:New Hampshire.text: New Hampshire is a state in northeast United States. It is one of six states in the New England region. The capital is Concord and its largest city is Manchester.

state:New Jersey.title: New Jersey
state:New Jersey.text: New Jersey is a state located in both the Mid-Atlantic and Northeastern regions of the United States. Located at the geographic hub of the heavily urbanized Northeast megalopolis, it is bordered to the northwest, north, and northeast by New York State; on its east, southeast, and south by the Atlantic Ocean; on its west by the Delaware River and Pennsylvania; and on its southwest by Delaware Bay and Delaware.

state:New Mexico.title: New Mexico
state:New Mexico.text: New Mexico is a state in the Southwestern region of the United States. The state's capital is Santa Fe and its largest city is Albuquerque. New Mexico borders Utah, Colorado, Arizona and Texas.

state:Nevada.title: Nevada
state:Nevada.text: Nevada is one of the United States' states. Its capital is Carson City. The largest city is Las Vegas. Other big cities are Henderson and Reno.

state:New York.title: New York (state)
state:New York.text: New York, also called New York State, is a state located in the Northeastern United States. Bordering New England to its east, Pennsylvania and New Jersey to the south, and Canada to its north, New York extends into both the Atlantic Ocean and the Great Lakes.

state:Ohio.title: Ohio
