state:Ohio.text: Ohio is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders the Canadian province of Ontario to the north, Pennsylvania to the east, West Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, Indiana to the west, and Michigan to the northwest. Ohio is the 34th-largest state by area, at 44,825 sq mi (116,100 km2), and the seventh-most populous state, with a population of nearly 11.9 million.

state:Oklahoma.title: Oklahoma
state:Oklahoma.text: Oklahoma is a state in the southern part of the Central United States. It had a population of about 3,959,353 people in 2020. The state has a land area of about 68,667 sq mi (177,847 km2).

state:Oregon.title: Oregon
state:Oregon.text: Oregon is a state in the United States. Salem is the capital, and Portland is the city with the most people. Oregon was the 33rd state to join the United States, in 1859.

state:Pennsylvania.title: Pennsylvania
state:Pennsylvania.text: Pennsylvania is one of the 50 states in the United States of America. It is in the northeastern part of the country. It has a border with the Canadian province of Ontario on the north, Ohio on the west, West Virginia on the south and west, Maryland and Delaware on the south, New Jersey on the east, and New York and Lake Erie on the north.

state:Rhode Island.title: Rhode Island
state:Rhode Island.text: Rhode Island is the smallest state in the United States by area. The capital and largest city is Providence. It is called the "Ocean state" because of its bays and waterways.

state:South Carolina.title: South Carolina
state:South Carolina.text: South Carolina is a state in the southeast United States. Its capital city is Columbia which with 137,300 people is the largest city in South Carolina by population. The population of the state is about 5.2 million people, ranked 23rd in the United States.

state:South Dakota.title: South Dakota
state:South Dakota.text: South Dakota is a state in the United States. South Dakota became a state on November 2, 1889. Its capital is Pierre and most populous is Sioux Falls.

state:Tennessee.title: Tennessee
state:Tennessee.text: Tennessee, officially the State of Tennessee, is a landlocked state in the Southeastern region of the United States. The capital and largest city is Nashville, which is the country music center of America. Tennessee borders eight states including Kentucky, Virginia, North Carolina, Georgia, Alabama, and Mississippi, Arkansas, and Missouri.

state:Texas.title: Texas
state:Texas.text: Texas, officially the State of Texas, is a state in the South Central Region of the United States. It is the second largest US state by total area with 268,596 sq mi and population with over 29 million people as of 2020. Its largest cities are Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth, San Antonio, El Paso, and Austin, the capital city.

state:Utah.title: Utah
state:Utah.text: Utah is a state in the western United States. Previously known as the Utah Territory, it was admitted to the Union in 1896 as the 45th U.S. state.

state:Virginia.title: Virginia
state:Virginia.text: Virginia, officially the Commonwealth of Virginia, is a state in the Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. The state's capital is Richmond and the largest city is Virginia Beach. Virginia borders eight states including Kentucky, Tennessee, North Carolina, Georgia, Alabama, and Mississippi, Arkansas, and Missouri.

state:Vermont.title: Vermont
state:Vermont.text: Vermont is a state in the United States. Its capital city is Montpelier, and its largest city is Burlington. It is one of the six New England states.

state:Washington.title: Washington (state)
state:Washington.text: Washington, officially the State of Washington, is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is north of Oregon, west of Idaho, east of the Pacific Ocean, and south of British Columbia.

state:Wisconsin.title: Wisconsin
state:Wisconsin.text: Wisconsin is a state in the Upper Midwest region of the United States. The capital of Wisconsin is Madison. The biggest city in Wisconsin is Milwaukee.

state:West Virginia.title: West Virginia
state:West Virginia.text: West Virginia is a state in the Appalachian region of the United States. Its capital and largest city is Charleston. It is often abbreviated W.

state:Wyoming.title: Wyoming
state:Wyoming.text: Wyoming is a state in the North-Western United States. Most of the state is in the Rocky Mountains,. Wyoming is the least populated U.S.

city:San Marino.title: San Marino
city:San Marino.text: San Marino is a country in Europe. It is one of the smallest countries in the world. It is in Southern Europe and is fully surrounded by Italy.

city:Vaduz.title: Vaduz
city:Vaduz.text: Vaduz is the capital of the country of Liechtenstein. It has a population of about 7,500 people.

city:Luxembourg.title: Luxembourg
city:Luxembourg.text: Luxembourg (officially called the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg is a landlocked country in Western Europe.

city:Palikir.title: Palikir
city:Palikir.text: Palikir is the capital city of the Federated States of Micronesia. It is on the island of Pohnpei. About 7,000 people live there.

city:Majuro.title: Majuro
city:Majuro.text: Majuro is the capital city of the country of the Marshall Islands. Built on 64 islands, Majuro has a port and an international airport. It has a population of 25,400 (2004).

city:Melekeok.title: Melekeok
city:Melekeok.text: Melekeok is a state of the Republic of Palau located on the central east coast of Babeldaob Island. The seat of government of the country, Ngerulmud, is located in the state. The state consists of long beaches, hills, steep ridges, rivers, and the largest and only natural freshwater lake in Palau and Micronesia, Lake Ngardok.

city:Tarawa.title: Tarawa
city:Tarawa.text: Tarawa is an atoll in the Republic of Kiribati. It is in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. It is made up of North Tarawa and South Tarawa.

city:Moroni.title: Moroni
city:Moroni.text: Moroni is a character in the Book of Mormon that was the final member of his people before they were all killed. Mormons believe that Moroni later appeared to Joseph Smith as an angel and gave him the Golden Plates from which Joseph translated the Book of Mormon.

city:Andorra.title: Andorra
city:Andorra.text: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked sovereign country located in the eastern Pyrenees Mountains of Southern Europe and bordered by Spain and France.

city:Port-of-Spain.title: Port of Spain
city:Port-of-Spain.text: Port of Spain is the capital and chief port of Trinidad and Tobago. With a municipal population of 49,867 (2017), an urban population of 81,142 and a transient daily population of 250,000, it is Trinidad and Tobago's third largest municipality, after Chaguanas and San Fernando.

city:Kigali.title: Kigali
city:Kigali.text: Kigali is the capital city of Rwanda. There are about 1,745,555 people living in it.

city:Mbabane.title: Mbabane
city:Mbabane.text: Mbabane is the capital city of the African country of Eswatini. It is on the Mbabane River and the Polinjane River in the Mdimba Mountains. The city is in the district of Hhohho and is also the district capital.

city:Ljubljana.title: Ljubljana
city:Ljubljana.text: Ljubljana is the capital city of Slovenia. It is the largest city in that country. The city became the most important settlement in the area when Romans ruled Slovenia.

city:Bratislava.title: Bratislava
city:Bratislava.text: Bratislava is the capital city of Slovakia. About 450,000 people live there. It used to be called Pressburg (German) or Pozsony (Hungarian) and by some other names.

city:Doha.title: Doha
city:Doha.text: Doha is the capital city of Qatar. It has a population of 673,000 (2025) and is at 25.3° N 51.5333° E, on the Persian Gulf. The city has an airport called Doha International Airport.

city:Podgorica.title: Podgorica
city:Podgorica.text: Podgorica is the capital and largest city of Montenegro. The city is located in central Montenegro, at the confluence of Ribnica and Morača rivers, where the southern foothills of Dinaric Alps meet the northernmost part of Zeta Plain.

city:Bern.title: Bern
city:Bern.text: Bern is the capital city of Switzerland. It is also the capital of the canton of Bern.

city:Pristina.title: Pristina
city:Pristina.text: Pristina or Prishtina ; Serbian: Приштина) is the capital city of Kosovo. It has a mostly Albanian population, but also some Serbs. It is in the north-eastern part of Kosovo, close to the Goljak mountains.

city:Roseau.title: Roseau
city:Roseau.text: Roseau is the capital city of the Caribbean island of Dominica. It is home to more than fourteen thousand people.

city:Djibouti.title: Djibouti
city:Djibouti.text: Djibouti, officially the Republic of Djibouti, is a country in the Horn of Africa, bordered by Somalia to the south, Ethiopia to the southwest, Eritrea in the north, and the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden to the east. The country has an area of 23,200 km2 (8,958 sq mi).

city:Banjul.title: Banjul
city:Banjul.text: Banjul is the capital city of the Gambia. About 31,000 people live in the city. But the total urban area is many times larger with 413,397 people.

city:Skopje.title: Skopje
city:Skopje.text: Skopje is the capital and the largest city of North Macedonia. The city is the administrative, cultural, economic and academic centre of the country. In the past, the city has been known by various names such as: Üsküp (Turkish) or Skoplje (Serbo-Croatian).

city:Bridgetown.title: Bridgetown
city:Bridgetown.text: The city of Bridgetown is the capital and largest city of the nation of Barbados. It was called the Town of Saint Michael. It is in the parish of Saint Michael.

city:Bujumbura.title: Bujumbura
city:Bujumbura.text: Bujumbura is the former capital city of Burundi. The city is at the northeastern corner of Lake Tanganyika. It is the largest city in the country.

city:Kingstown.title: Kingstown
city:Kingstown.text: Kingstown is the capital city of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. The population of Kingstown as of 2008 is 24,518. Kingstown exports bananas, coconuts, and arrowroot.

city:Castries.title: Castries
city:Castries.text: Castries is the capital city of Saint Lucia. Saint Lucia is an island in the Windward Islands, which is part of the Caribbean. Castries has a population of about 3,600 people, about 16,000 live near the city.

city:Basseterre.title: Basseterre
city:Basseterre.text: Basseterre, is the capital city of the Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis, also called St Kitts and Nevis, in the West Indies. Basseterre port is at 17°18′N 62°44′W, on the south western coast of Saint Kitts Island. It is one of the chief commercial depots of the Leeward Islands.

city:Port Louis.title: Port Louis
city:Port Louis.text: Port Louis is the capital city of the African country of Mauritius. The city is a port on the Indian Ocean. It is the largest city and main port of the country.

city:Saint George's.title: St. George's, Grenada
city:Saint George's.text: St. George's is the capital and largest city of Grenada. The city is surrounded by a hillside of an old volcano crater and is located on a horseshoe-shaped harbour.

city:Manama.title: Manama
city:Manama.text: Manama is the capital and largest city of Bahrain, with an approximate population of 743,066 as of the 2025 estimate. Long an important trading center in the Persian Gulf, Manama is home to a diverse population.

city:Montevideo.title: Montevideo
city:Montevideo.text: Montevideo is the capital and largest city of Uruguay. As of the 2023 census, the city proper has a population of 1,287,452, making up about 36.8% of the country's total population, in an area of 201 square kilometers (78 sq mi). Montevideo is situated on the southern coast of the country, on the northeastern bank of the Río de la Plata.

city:Lomé.title: Lomé
city:Lomé.text: Lomé is the capital city of Togo. Lomé is the administrative and industrial center of the country. The city is also the main port of Togo.

city:Tunis.title: Tunis
city:Tunis.text: Tunis is the capital city of Tunisia. As of 2004, 728,463 people lived in the city. About 1.6 million live in the metropolitan area.

city:Abu Dhabi.title: Abu Dhabi
city:Abu Dhabi.text: Abu Dhabi is the capital city of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, the seat of the Abu Dhabi Central Capital District and the UAE's second-most populous city, after Dubai. Situated on a T-shaped island, Abu Dhabi extends into the Persian Gulf from the central-western coast of the UAE.

city:Ashgabat.title: Ashgabat
city:Ashgabat.text: Ashgabat is the capital and largest city of Turkmenistan. It lies between the Karakum Desert and the Köpetdag mountain range in Central Asia, approximately 50 km (30 mi) away from the Iran-Turkmenistan border. The city has a population of 1,030,063.

city:Lusaka.title: Lusaka
city:Lusaka.text: Lusaka is the capital and largest city of Zambia. It is one of the fastest-developing cities in southern Africa. Lusaka is in the southern part of the central plateau at an elevation of about 1,279 metres (4,196 ft).

city:Harare.title: Harare
city:Harare.text: Harare is the capital and largest city of Zimbabwe. The city proper has an area of 982.3 km2 (379.3 sq mi), a population of 1,849,600 as of the 2022 census, and an estimated 2,487,209 people in its metropolitan province. The city is situated in north-eastern Zimbabwe in the country's Mashonaland region.

city:Dili.title: Dili
city:Dili.text: Dili is the capital and largest city of Timor-Leste. It lies on the northern coast of the island of Timor, in a small area of flat land hemmed in by mountains. The climate is tropical with distinct wet and dry seasons.

city:Port Vila.title: Port Vila
city:Port Vila.text: Port Vila, or simply Vila, is the capital of Vanuatu and its largest city. It is on the island of Efate, in Shefa Province. The population was 49,034 as of the 2020 Vanuatu census.

city:Tegucigalpa.title: Tegucigalpa
city:Tegucigalpa.text: Tegucigalpa is the capital and largest city of Honduras. With a total population of 1,526,660 people as of 2022.

city:Georgetown.title: Georgetown, Guyana
city:Georgetown.text: Georgetown is the capital city of Guyana. It is located in the Demerara-Mahaica region. It is the country's largest city.

city:Reykjavík.title: Reykjavík
city:Reykjavík.text: Reykjavík is the capital city of the island country of Iceland. It is also the largest city in that country. The population of Reykyavík is over 117,000 people.

city:Port-au-Prince.title: Port-au-Prince
city:Port-au-Prince.text: Port-au-Prince is the capital city of Haiti. Haiti is also divided into ten Départements; Port-au-Prince is the capital of the Ouest Département.

city:Kampala.title: Kampala
city:Kampala.text: Kampala is the capital of Uganda. More than 1,800,000 people live there. The city is on the shore of Lake Victoria.

city:Paramaribo.title: Paramaribo
city:Paramaribo.text: Paramaribo is the capital city of Suriname. About 250,000 people live in the city. It is at the Suriname River about 15 km before the river flows into the Atlantic Ocean.

city:Niamey.title: Niamey
city:Niamey.text: Niamey is the capital city of the African country of Niger. It is Niger's largest city. The city is on the Niger River. Niamey is the administrative, cultural and economic center of the country.

city:Dushanbe.title: Dushanbe
city:Dushanbe.text: Dushanbe is the capital city of Tajikistan. About 562,000 people live in Dushanbe as of 2000. The name is borrowed from the Persian word for "Monday" and refers to the fact that it was a popular "Monday" market place.

city:Asunción.title: Asunción
city:Asunción.text: Asunción, is the capital city and largest city of Paraguay. The city has more than 1.2 million inhabitants, and the metropolitan area has more than 1.8 million inhabitants. It is on the left bank of the Paraguay River and is the main seaport of Paraguay.

city:Managua.title: Managua
city:Managua.text: Managua has been the capital city of Nicaragua since 1855. There had been an Indian settlement there before the Spanish, but the modern city was founded as Leal Villa de Santiago de Managua in 1811. Before 1855, León and Granada were the capital cities.

city:Freetown.title: Freetown
city:Freetown.text: Freetown is the capital city of the African country of Sierra Leone. With a population of 951,000 people, it is the largest city in that country. The city is a port on the Freetown Peninsula on the Atlantic coast.

city:Islamabad.title: Islamabad
city:Islamabad.text: Islamabad is the Federal capital city of Pakistan. The city is located on the Pothohar Plateau in the northwest of the country. It is in the Islamabad Capital Territory, though the area has historically been a part of the Pothohar region on the crossroads of the Punjab region and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province .

city:Kathmandu.title: Kathmandu
city:Kathmandu.text: Kathmandu is the capital city of Nepal. It is the largest city of Nepal. The population of the capital city was 856,767 according to the 2021 census.

city:Bloemfontein.title: Bloemfontein
city:Bloemfontein.text: Bloemfontein is one of the three capital cites of South Africa. It is the law capital of South Africa, as the Supreme Court is there. In Afrikaans and Dutch, Bloemfontein means "Spring of Bloem (Bloom)".

city:Pretoria.title: Pretoria
city:Pretoria.text: Pretoria is one of the three capital cities of the African country of South Africa. It is the executive and de facto capital of the country. The other two capitals are Cape Town (legislative) and Bloemfontein (judicial).

city:Port Moresby.title: Port Moresby
city:Port Moresby.text: Port Moresby is the capital city and the main city of Papua New Guinea. In 2000, 255,000 people lived there. The city is on the shores of the Gulf of Papua, on the southeastern coast of the island of New Guinea.

city:Honiara.title: Honiara
city:Honiara.text: Honiara is the capital city of Solomon Islands and of Guadalcanal Province. It has a population 84,520 (2017).

city:Panama City.title: Panama City
city:Panama City.text: Panama City is the capital of Panama. 813,097 people live there. It is now a popular place for older people or senior citizens to retire.

city:Rabat.title: Rabat
city:Rabat.text: Rabat, population 577,827 hab., is the capital of the Kingdom of Morocco. It is also the capital of the Rabat-Salé-Kénitra region.

city:Chișinău.title: Chișinău
city:Chișinău.text: Chișinău, formerly known as Kishinev, is the capital city and industrial and commercial center of Moldova. It is also largest city of Moldova. It is located in the center of the country – on the river Bîc.

city:Maputo.title: Maputo
city:Maputo.text: Maputo is the capital of Mozambique. It is on the coast of the Indian Ocean. As of 2004, about 1,114,000 people live in the city.

city:Mogadishu.title: Mogadishu
city:Mogadishu.text: Mogadishu is the capital city of the African country of Somalia. It is also the largest city in that country. It is located in the coastal Banadir region on the Somali Sea.

city:Muscat.title: Muscat
city:Muscat.text: Muscat is the capital and largest city of The Sultanate of Oman. It is the largest city in the mintaqah (governorate) of Muscat. The city of Muscat has a population of 1.28 million people (2015).

city:Colombo.title: Colombo
city:Colombo.text: Colombo is the largest city of Sri Lanka. It is the city which is economically most important to the country. It has 642,163 people.

city:Ulaanbaatar.title: Ulaanbaatar
city:Ulaanbaatar.text: Ulaanbaatar, or Ulan Bator, is the capital and largest city of Mongolia. The city is an independent municipality not part of any provinces. About half the population of Mongolia, about 1.5 million people, live in the city.

city:Windhoek.title: Windhoek
city:Windhoek.text: Windhoek is the capital city of Namibia. It has a population of 230,000 people. Windhoek is the trade center for sheep skins.

city:Abuja.title: Abuja
city:Abuja.text: Abuja is a city in Nigeria. It is the national capital of Nigeria. Around 2.5 million people live there. Abuja is in the middle of the country, in the center of the Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria.

city:Bissau.title: Bissau
city:Bissau.text: Bissau is the capital city of Guinea-Bissau. It is also the largest city in the country; around 355,000 people live there. The city is where the Geba river flows into the Atlantic Ocean.

city:Amman.title: Amman
city:Amman.text: Amman, is the capital of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and the capital of the Amman Governorate. It is the largest city in the Kingdom and one of the largest Arab cities in terms of population, with a population in 2014 of about 4 million, which also makes it one of the fastest growing cities in the world.

city:Vilnius.title: Vilnius
city:Vilnius.text: Vilnius is the largest city and the capital of Lithuania, with a population of 553,904 as of December 2005. It is the seat of the Vilnius city municipality and of the Vilnius district municipality. It is also the capital of Vilnius County.

city:Riga.title: Riga
city:Riga.text: Riga is the capital city of the European country of Latvia. Riga is on river Daugava near the Baltic Sea. The historical center of Riga is in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage List and is notable for its Art Nouveau architecture, which, according to UNESCO, has no equal in the world.

city:Bishkek.title: Bishkek
city:Bishkek.text: Bishkek is the capital city of Kyrgyzstan. It has a population of 900,000 (2005). It was originally founded in 1878 as the Russian fortress of Pishpek (Пишпек).

city:Maseru.title: Maseru
city:Maseru.text: Maseru is the capital city of Lesotho. It is near Mohokare River. Maseru is on the border with South Africa, and is connected to it through Maseru Bridge.

city:Antananarivo.title: Antananarivo
city:Antananarivo.text: Antananarivo is the capital city of Madagascar. It is the largest city in the country. The city is the administrative, communications and economic center of Madagascar.

city:Quito.title: Quito
city:Quito.text: Quito is the capital city of Ecuador. As of 2020, about 2.011 million people lived there. Quito is the second largest city in Ecuador after Guayaquil.

city:San José.title: San José, Costa Rica
city:San José.text: San José is the capital of Costa Rica, head of San José Province, and the nation's largest city. It is named in honor of Saint Joseph. It is in the center of the Gran Area Metropolitana of the Central Valley.

city:San Salvador.title: San Salvador
city:San Salvador.text: San Salvador is the capital city and the largest city of El Salvador. It is the country's largest agglomeration, serving as the country's political, cultural, educational and financial center. San Salvador has a population of 330,000.

city:Kingston.title: Kingston, Jamaica
city:Kingston.text: The City of Kingston is the capital and largest city of Jamaica. It is on the southeastern coast of the island country. It faces a natural harbour protected by the Palisadoes, a long sand spit which connects Port Royal and the norman Manley International Airport to the rest of the island.

city:N'Djamena.title: N'Djamena
city:N'Djamena.text: N'Djamena is the capital of Chad. It is the largest city in the country. The city is a port on the Chari River. N'Djamena is also a special statute region.

city:Malabo.title: Malabo
city:Malabo.text: Malabo is a city in Equatorial Guinea, located in the province of Bioko Norte. It is located on the north coast of the island of Bioko. In 2018, the city had a population of approximately 297,000 inhabitants.

city:Asmara.title: Asmara
city:Asmara.text: Asmara is the capital city of Eritrea. It is the largest settlement in the country. Asmara has a population of about 579,000 people.

city:Zagreb.title: Zagreb
city:Zagreb.text: Zagreb is the capital city and the largest city of the country of Croatia. It has a population of 792.000 people and its metropolitan area has a population of 1.2 million (2005).

city:Tallinn.title: Tallinn
city:Tallinn.text: Tallinn is the capital and largest city of Estonia. Located on a bay in northern Estonia, on the shore of the Gulf of Finland of the Baltic Sea, it has a population of 452,563 as of 2026, making it the third most-populous city in the Baltics. As of 2024, the population of the Tallinn metropolitan area is estimated at 646,315.

city:Lilongwe.title: Lilongwe
city:Lilongwe.text: Lilongwe is the capital and largest city of Malawi. It has a population of 989,318 as of the 2018 Census, up from a population of 674,448 in 2008. In 2020, that figure was 1,122,000.

city:Guatemala City.title: Guatemala City
city:Guatemala City.text: Guatemala City, also known colloquially by the nickname Guate, is the national capital and largest city of the Republic of Guatemala. It serves as the municipal capital of the surrounding Guatemala Department. Its metropolitan area is also the largest in Central America.

city:Libreville.title: Libreville
city:Libreville.text: Libreville is the capital and largest city of Gabon, located on the Gabon Estuary. Libreville occupies 65 square kilometres (25 sq mi) of the northwestern province of Estuaire. Libreville is also a port on the Gabon Estuary, near the Gulf of Guinea.

city:Suva.title: Suva
city:Suva.text: Suva is the capital and most populous settlement of Fiji. It is the centre of Fiji's largest metropolitan area and serves as its major port. The city is on the southeast coast of the island of Viti Levu, in Rewa Province, Central Division.

city:Nouakchott.title: Nouakchott
city:Nouakchott.text: Nouakchott is the capital city of the African county of Mauritania. It is the largest city in that country and one of the largest cities on the Sahara Desert. The city is the administrative and economic centre of Mauritania.

city:Bamako.title: Bamako
city:Bamako.text: Bamako is the capital and largest city of Mali with a 2022 population of 4,227,569. It is located on the Niger River, near the rapids that divide the upper and middle Niger valleys in the southwestern part of the country, and the city is surrounded on all sides by the Koulikoro Region.

city:Beirut.title: Beirut
city:Beirut.text: Beirut is the capital of Lebanon. It is one of the richest and oldest continuously inhabited cities of the world. It is on a hilly promontory on the eastern Mediterranean surrounded to the east by the snow-capped mountains of Lebanon.

city:Tbilisi.title: Tbilisi
city:Tbilisi.text: Tbilisi is the capital and largest city of Georgia, located on the banks of the Kura River. With more than 1.3 million inhabitants, it contains almost one third of the country's population. Tbilisi was founded in the 5th century CE by Vakhtang I of Iberia and has since served as the capital of various Georgian kingdoms and republics.

city:Nur-Sultan.title: Astana
city:Nur-Sultan.text: Astana is the capital city of Kazakhstan. With a population of 1.7 million within the city limits, it is the second-largest in the country after Almaty, the national capital until 1997. The city lies on the banks of the Ishim river in the north of Kazakhstan and is located within the Akmola Region but is self-administering.

city:Vientiane.title: Vientiane
city:Vientiane.text: Vientiane is the capital and largest city of Laos. Comprising the 5 urban districts of Vientiane Prefecture, the city is located on the banks of the Mekong, close to the border with Thailand. Vientiane was the administrative capital during French rule.

city:Brazzaville.title: Brazzaville
city:Brazzaville.text: Brazzaville is the capital city of the Republic of the Congo. One million people live there. Brazzaville is on one side of the Congo river, with Kinshasa on the other side.

city:Conakry.title: Conakry
city:Conakry.text: Conakry or Konakry is the capital and largest city of Guinea. The city is a port on the Atlantic Ocean. The population of Conakry is about 2 million people.

city:Yamoussoukro.title: Yamoussoukro
city:Yamoussoukro.text: Yamoussoukro is the capital city of Côte d'Ivoire. About 200,000 people live in this city. Yamoussoukro became the capital in 1983.

city:Ottawa.title: Ottawa
city:Ottawa.text: Ottawa is the capital of Canada and is part of the province of Ontario. It is south of the Ottawa River. In 2004, there were about 808,391 people in the city.

city:Belgrade.title: Belgrade
city:Belgrade.text: Belgrade is the capital city of the country of Serbia. Before the wars of the 1990s, it was the capital of Yugoslavia from 1918 to 1992 after the Kingdom of Serbia collapsed in 1918 along with Austria-Hungary after World War 1.

city:Bandar Seri Begawan.title: Bandar Seri Begawan
city:Bandar Seri Begawan.text: Bandar Seri Begawan is the capital city of Brunei and the largest city. It has a population of 140,000. The city is the home of producers of furniture, textiles, handcrafts, and timber.

city:Sucre.title: Sucre
city:Sucre.text: Sucre is the capital city of Bolivia. It was also known as Charcas, La Plata, and Chuquisaca in the past. About 250,000 people lived there in 2006.

city:Belmopan.title: Belmopan
city:Belmopan.text: Belmopan is the capital city of Belize. There are about 20,000 people living there.

city:Bangui.title: Bangui
city:Bangui.text: Bangui is the capital city of Central African Republic. It is the largest city in the country. The city has a population of 531,763 people.

city:Yaoundé.title: Yaoundé
city:Yaoundé.text: Yaoundé is the capital city of the Republic of Cameroon. It is the second largest city in the country after Douala.

city:Tirana.title: Tirana
city:Tirana.text: Tirana is the capital and largest city of Albania. It is located in the centre of the country, enclosed by mountains and hills with Dajti rising to the east and a slight valley to the northwest overlooking the Adriatic Sea in the distance. It is among the wettest and sunniest cities in Europe, with 2,544 hours of sun per year.

city:Yerevan.title: Yerevan
city:Yerevan.text: Yerevan is the capital and largest city of Armenia. In 2004 about 1,088,300 people lived in Yerevan. Some people write Yerevan as Erevan.

city:Baku.title: Baku
city:Baku.text: Baku is the capital and largest city of Azerbaijan, as well as the largest city on the Caspian Sea and in the Caucasus region. Baku is 28 metres (92 ft) below sea level, which makes it the lowest lying national capital in the world and the largest city in the world below sea level. Baku lies on the southern shore of the Absheron Peninsula, along the Bay of Baku.

city:Phnom Penh.title: Phnom Penh
city:Phnom Penh.text: Phnom Penh is the capital of Cambodia. It is the largest and most populous city in the country. It is also the capital of the Phnom Penh administrative city.

city:La Paz.title: La Paz
city:La Paz.text: Nuestra Señora de La Paz is the capital of Bolivia, and La Paz Department. It is the second largest city only after Santa Cruz de la Sierra. It is in the western part of the country in the department of the same name.

city:Cotonou.title: Cotonou
city:Cotonou.text: Cotonou is the economy capital of Benin. It is the largest city in that country. The city officially has 761,137 people, but it is thought that the actual number of people living in the city may be as high as 1.2 million.

city:Sofia.title: Sofia
city:Sofia.text: Sofia is the capital and the largest city of Republic of Bulgaria. Sofia means wiseness in Greek language and in Ancient Greek language. It has 1.3 million people.

city:Minsk.title: Minsk
city:Minsk.text: Minsk or Miensk is the capital and a major city of Belarus. About 2 million people lived in the city as of 2021. Minsk is also a headquarters of the Commonwealth of Independent States.

city:Thimphu.title: Thimphu
city:Thimphu.text: Thimphu (ཐིམ་ཕུ་) is the capital city of Bhutan. It is the name of the surrounding valley and dzongkhag, the Thimphu District. It has a population of 50,000 (2003), it is the largest population center in the country.

city:Gaborone.title: Gaborone
city:Gaborone.text: Gaborone is the capital city of Botswana. It has a population of 231,626 people. Gaborone is one of the fastest-growing cities in Africa.

city:Canberra.title: Canberra
city:Canberra.text: Canberra is the capital city of Australia. There are 403,468 people who live there. It does not belong to a state but it is in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT).

city:Ouagadougou.title: Ouagadougou
city:Ouagadougou.text: Ouagadougou (, is the capital of Burkina Faso. It is also the country's biggest city. In Ouagadougou, people mainly make clothing and food.

city:Sarajevo.title: Sarajevo
city:Sarajevo.text: Sarajevo is the capital city of Bosnia and Herzegovina. It has an estimated population of 436,000 people in the urban area including some municipalities from City of East Sarajevo which is the part of Republika Srpska entity. The city has people living in it from many different cultures.

city:Naypyidaw.title: Naypyidaw
city:Naypyidaw.text: Naypyidaw, also known Nay Pyi Taw or Naypyitaw, is the capital city of Myanmar, also known as Burma.

city:Nuku'alofa.title: Nukuʻalofa
city:Nuku'alofa.text: Nukuʻalofa is the capital city of Tonga. It is on the island of Tongatapu.

city:Hargeisa.title: Hargeisa
city:Hargeisa.text: Hargeisa is the largest and capital city of the Republic of Somaliland. It is also the regional capital of the Waqooyi galbeed province of Somalia.

city:Victoria.title: Victoria, Seychelles
city:Victoria.text: Victoria is the capital city of the Republic of Seychelles. It is on the north-eastern side of Mahé island, which the main island of the archipelago. The city was first created as the capital of the British colonial government.

city:São Tomé.title: São Tomé
city:São Tomé.text: São Tomé is the capital city of São Tomé and Príncipe. It is the largest city in the country. The city has a population of 56,166 people.

city:Apia.title: Apia
city:Apia.text: Apia, is the capital of Samoa. In 2001, it had 380,800 people. It is part of the Tuamasaga district. The city is on the northern coast of Upolu Island.

city:Valletta.title: Valletta
city:Valletta.text: Valletta is the capital city of Malta. It was founded by Jean Parisot de la Valette, the Grandmaster of the Order of Saint John on March 28, 1566. The city's population is 6,315 and it is currently decreasing as people move to the UK, Italy, or the newer areas of Malta.

city:Malé.title: Malé
city:Malé.text: Malé is the capital and most populous city of the Maldives. With a population of 211,908 in 2022 within its administrative area and coterminous geographical area of 1.9 square kilometres (0.73 sq mi), Malé is one of the most densely populated cities in the world. The city is geographically located in the southern edge of North Malé Atoll.

city:Jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
city:Jerusalem.text: Jerusalem is one of the oldest cities in the world that people have lived in continuously.

city:Praia.title: Praia
city:Praia.text: Praia is the capital of the island nation of Cape Verde. It lies on Santiago island in the Sotavento archipelago. The city has, in 2010, a population of 127,832.

city:Nassau.title: Nassau, Bahamas
city:Nassau.text: Nassau is the largest city and the capital of the Bahamas. Nassau is on New Providence Island. In 2008 about 260,000 people lived in Nassau.

city:Nicosia.title: Nicosia
city:Nicosia.text: Nicosia, also known as Lefkosia is the capital city and largest city of the island country of Cyprus. Nicosia is on the Pedieos (Kanlidere) river in the centre of the island. The city is the seat of government as well as the main business centre for Cyprus.

city:Wellington.title: Wellington
city:Wellington.text: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand. It has been the capital since 1865. Before then Auckland was the capital. Wellington is the second largest city in New Zealand.

city:Hanoi.title: Hanoi
city:Hanoi.text: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam. It is also the second most populated city in the country. In 2023, about 5,253,000 people lived in the city.

city:Ankara.title: Ankara
city:Ankara.text: Ankara is the capital city of the country of Turkey. It is in the center of Anatolia. It is the second most populated city after Istanbul.

city:Budapest.title: Budapest
city:Budapest.text: Budapest is the capital and largest city of Hungary. It was made as such in 1873. In that year, three towns on the River Danube, namely Buda, Óbuda and Pest were united.

city:Sanaa.title: Sana'a
city:Sanaa.text: Sana'a or Sanˤā', is the capital city of Yemen and the capital of Sana'a Governorate, but instead forms the separate governorate of ʾAmānat al-ʿĀṣimah. It had a population of 1,747,627.

city:Bucharest.title: Bucharest
city:Bucharest.text: Bucharest is the capital city of Romania. It is the largest city in the country. The city has a population of 1.9 million people.

city:Damascus.title: Damascus
city:Damascus.text: Damascus is the capital city of Syria. In Arabic, its name is Dimashq (دمشق). It is the largest city in Syria with about 4.8 million people living there.

city:Lisbon.title: Lisbon
city:Lisbon.text: Lisbon is the capital city of Portugal. It is the largest city of Portugal. The city has a population of about half million people.

city:Khartoum.title: Khartoum
city:Khartoum.text: Khartoum, also spelled Khartum, is the capital and most populous city of Sudan as well as Khartoum State. With an estimated population of 7.1 million people, Greater Khartoum is the largest urban area in Sudan.

city:Oslo.title: Oslo
city:Oslo.text: Oslo is the capital and largest city of Norway. It constitutes both a county and a municipality. The municipality of Oslo had a population of 724,290 in 2025, while the city's greater urban area had a population of 1,110,887 in 2025, and the metropolitan area had an estimated population of 1,546,706 in 2021.

city:Warsaw.title: Warsaw
city:Warsaw.text: Warsaw, officially the Capital City of Warsaw, is the capital and most populous city of Poland. The metropolis stands on the river Vistula in east-central Poland. Its population is officially estimated at 1.87 million residents within a greater metropolitan area of around 3.5 million residents, which makes Warsaw the 7th most populous city in the European Union.

city:Pyongyang.title: Pyongyang
city:Pyongyang.text: Pyongyang (Korean: 평양) is the capital and largest city of North Korea. According to the 2008 population census, it has a population of 3,255,288. Pyongyang is located on the Taedong River about 109 kilometers upstream from its mouth on the Yellow Sea.

city:Dar es Salaam.title: Dar es Salaam
city:Dar es Salaam.text: Dar es Salaam is the largest city and financial hub of Tanzania and capital of the Dar es Salaam Region. It is located on the Swahili coast. With a population of over 7 million people, Dar es Salaam is the largest city in East Africa by population and the fifth-largest in Africa.

city:Dublin.title: Dublin
city:Dublin.text: Dublin is the capital and largest city of Ireland. Situated on Dublin Bay at the mouth of the River Liffey, it is in the province of Leinster, and is bordered on the south by the Dublin Mountains, part of the Wicklow Mountains range.

city:Monrovia.title: Monrovia
city:Monrovia.text: Monrovia is the capital and largest city of the African country of Liberia. Founded in 1822, it is located on Cape Mesurado on the Atlantic coast and, as of the 2022 census, had a population of 1,761,032 residents. Its largely urbanized metropolitan area, including Montserrado and Margibi counties, was home to 2,225,911 inhabitants as of the 2022 census, representing 33.5% of Liberia’s total population.

city:Kuala Lumpur.title: Kuala Lumpur
city:Kuala Lumpur.text: Kuala Lumpur is the capital city and the largest city of Malaysia and a Federal Territory. After Putrajaya was constructed in the late 1990s, the administrative capital has been moved there. Kuala Lumpur has one of the tallest buildings in the world, the Petronas Twin Towers.

city:Havana.title: Havana
city:Havana.text: Havana is the capital city of Cuba. It is the largest city of Cuba and of the Caribbean. Its population was 2.1 million in the census of 2012.

city:Prague.title: Prague
city:Prague.text: Prague is the capital and largest city of the Czech Republic and the historical capital of Bohemia. Located on the Vltava River, the city has a population of about 1.4 million, making it the twelfth-largest city in the European Union. Its metropolitan area is home to approximately 2.3 million people.

city:Kuwait City.title: Kuwait City
city:Kuwait City.text: Kuwait City is the capital and largest city of Kuwait. Located at the heart of the country on the south shore of Kuwait Bay on the Persian Gulf, it is the political, cultural and economic primate city of the emirate, being home to the headquarters of most Kuwaiti corporations and the entirety of its banking system.

city:Santo Domingo.title: Santo Domingo
city:Santo Domingo.text: Santo Domingo, officially known as Santo Domingo de Guzmán, is the capital and largest city of the Dominican Republic and the largest metropolitan area in the Caribbean by population. As of 2022, the city center had a population of 1,029,110 while its metropolitan area, Greater Santo Domingo, had a population of 4,274,651.

city:Accra.title: Accra
city:Accra.text: Accra is the capital city of Ghana. It has a population of about 1,970,400 (2005). The city is Ghana's largest city. It is also the administrative, communications, and economic center of the country.

city:Tripoli.title: Tripoli
city:Tripoli.text: Tripoli is a city in northwest Libya. It is the capital of the country. More than three million people live in the metropolitan area.

city:Helsinki.title: Helsinki
city:Helsinki.text: Helsinki is the capital city of Finland. Helsinki is the largest city in Finland. 604,380 (31.12.2012) people live in Helsinki, and 1,360,000 live in the Helsinki metropolitan area.

city:København.title: Copenhagen
city:København.text: Copenhagen is the capital city of Denmark. It is also the largest city in Denmark. In 2014, 1,246,611 people lived in the urban area.

city:Abidjan.title: Abidjan
city:Abidjan.text: Abidjan is the largest city and former capital of Ivory Coast. It is the commercial and banking center of Ivory Coast as well as the de facto capital. Yamoussoukro is the official capital.

city:Brasília.title: Brasília
city:Brasília.text: Brasília is the capital city of Brazil. The name is commonly spelled Brasilia in English. The city and its Federal District are in the Central-West region of the country.

city:Brussels.title: Brussels
city:Brussels.text: Brussels is the capital city of Belgium and the European Union.

city:Dhaka.title: Dhaka
city:Dhaka.text: Dhaka is the capital and largest city of Bangladesh. Dhaka is a megacity, and has a population of 10.2 million residents as of 2022, and a population of over 22.4 million residents in Greater Dhaka. It is widely considered to be one of the most densely populated built-up urban area in the world.

city:Luanda.title: Luanda
city:Luanda.text: Luanda is the capital and the largest city of Angola. Its former name was Loanda. It is a main seaport of the country on the Atlantic Ocean.

city:Algiers.title: Algiers
city:Algiers.text: Algiers is the capital of Algeria which is a North African country. It is the biggest city of the country. The white buildings make it commonly referred to as Alger la Blanche.

city:Yangon.title: Yangon
city:Yangon.text: Yangon also known as Rangoon, is the largest city in Myanmar. It was also the capital city until 2006. The city is by a river called Hlaing River, and is close to the sea.

city:Caracas.title: Caracas
city:Caracas.text: Caracas, officially Santiago de León de Caracas (CCS), is the capital and largest city of Venezuela, and the center of the Metropolitan Region of Caracas. It is located along the Guaire River in the northern part of Venezuela, within the Caracas Valley of the Venezuelan coastal mountain range.

city:Kyiv.title: Kyiv
city:Kyiv.text: Kyiv or Kiev is the capital and largest city in Ukraine. It is in north-central Ukraine on the Dnipro River. Over three million people live there.

city:Tashkent.title: Tashkent
city:Tashkent.text: Tashkent is the capital city of Uzbekistan. It is also the most populated city in Central Asia, with a population of 2,603,000 in 2023. Its name means "Stone City" in English.

city:Madrid.title: Madrid
city:Madrid.text: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain. Madrid is in the middle of Spain, in the Community of Madrid. The Community is a large area that includes the city as well as small towns and villages outside the city.

city:Stockholm.title: Stockholm
city:Stockholm.text: Stockholm is the capital city of Sweden. It is also the biggest city in Sweden. It is on the east coast of the country. The city is built on islands, with canals and open water in the inner city.

city:Bangkok.title: Bangkok
city:Bangkok.text: Bangkok is the capital city of Thailand. In 2010, the city had a population of 9,100,000 people. Since Bangkok has more than 55 times as many people as the second largest city, Nonthaburi, it is a primate city.

city:Lima.title: Lima
city:Lima.text: Lima is the capital city, and is considered the most important and largest city of Peru. 75% of the Peruvian economy is handled in Lima. Lima is the industrial and financial center of Peru, and one of the most important financial centers in Latin America.

city:Dakar.title: Dakar
city:Dakar.text: Dakar is the capital city of Senegal. It is on the country's Atlantic coast on the western edge of Africa. The city is a trade seaport for items leaving Africa.

city:Johannesburg.title: Johannesburg
city:Johannesburg.text: Johannesburg is the largest city in South Africa. It is the capital of the Gauteng Province. It was founded on October 4, 1886 and has the JSE Securities Exchange, which is the largest stock exchange in Africa.

city:Amsterdam.title: Amsterdam
city:Amsterdam.text: Amsterdam is the capital and largest city in the European country of the Netherlands. Amsterdam is famous for its canals. Unlike in capitals of most other countries, the national government, parliament, government ministries, supreme court, royal family and embassies are not in Amsterdam, but in The Hague.

city:Seoul.title: Seoul
city:Seoul.text: Seoul is the biggest city of the Republic of Korea, and its capital. Its official name is Seoul Special City. It has a population of 10 million which is about 1/5 of the Korean population and 1/7 of Korea peninsula, and covers an area of 610 km² that is only 0.6% of South Korea.

city:Manila.title: Manila
city:Manila.text: Manila is the capital city of the Philippines. It is one of the largest cities in the Philippines. Manila is on the biggest island of the Philippines, Luzon.

city:Berlin.title: Berlin
city:Berlin.text: Berlin ) is the capital city of Germany. It is the largest city in the European Union by population, with around 3.7 million people in 2024. Berlin residents come from about 190 different countries.

city:Kinshasa.title: Kinshasa
city:Kinshasa.text: Kinshasa is the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is the third largest city in the continent of Africa. About eleven million people live there.

city:New Delhi.title: New Delhi
city:New Delhi.text: New Delhi is the capital city of India and a part of the National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT). New Delhi is the seat of all three branches of the Government of India, hosting the Rashtrapati Bhavan, Sansad Bhavan, and the Supreme Court. New Delhi is a municipality within the NCT, administered by the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC), which covers mostly Lutyens' Delhi and a few adjacent areas.

city:Athens.title: Athens
city:Athens.text: Athens is one of the most famous cities in the world. It is the capital city of Greece and the most important financial, industrial, maritime, political, and cultural center of the country.

city:Baghdad.title: Baghdad
city:Baghdad.text: Baghdad is the capital city and largest city in Iraq. It is the second-largest city in Southwest Asia after Tehran. It is the second-largest city in the Arab world after Cairo.

city:Addis Ababa.title: Addis Ababa
city:Addis Ababa.text: Addis Ababa is the capital city of Ethiopia. It is also the political capital of the African Union.

city:Tehran.title: Tehran
city:Tehran.text: Tehran is the capital and largest city of Iran. It is also the capital of Tehran province and the administrative center for Tehran County and its Central District.

city:Buenos Aires.title: Buenos Aires
city:Buenos Aires.text: Buenos Aires is the capital and largest city in the South American country of Argentina. It has its own executive, legislative and judicial powers. It is in the central-eastern region of the country, on the southern shore of the Río de la Plata, in the Pampas region.

city:Kabul.title: Kabul
city:Kabul.text: Kabul is the capital and largest city of Afghanistan.

city:Vienna.title: Vienna
city:Vienna.text: Vienna ; Central Austro-Bavarian: Wean [veɐ̯n]; Viennese German and Austrian German: Wian []) is the capital and largest city of Austria. It is also one of Austria's nine states.

city:Taipei.title: Taipei
city:Taipei.text: Taipei City is the capital city of the Republic of China, known by most people simply as Taiwan. It is the largest city in Taiwan. It has a monsoon humid subtropical climate.

city:Washington, D.C..title: Washington, D.C.
city:Washington, D.C..text: Washington, D.C. is the capital city of the United States of America. It is a federal district. The President of the United States, the United States Congress, the United States Supreme Court and many major national government offices are in the territory.

city:London.title: London
city:London.text: London is the capital and largest city of both England and its surrounding area.

city:Riyadh.title: Riyadh
city:Riyadh.text: Riyadh is the capital and most populous city of Saudi Arabia. It is also the capital of Riyadh Province, and belongs to the historical regions of Nejd and Al-Yamama. It is in the center of the Arabian Peninsula on a large plateau and is home to 6.5 million people.

city:Cape Town.title: Cape Town
city:Cape Town.text: Cape Town is the legislative capital of South Africa. It is the country's oldest city and the seat of the Parliament of South Africa. Cape Town is the capital and largest city of the Western Cape, and the country's second-most populous city, after Johannesburg.

city:Moscow.title: Moscow
city:Moscow.text: Moscow is the capital and largest city of Russia, situated on the Moskva River in Central Russia. The city has a population estimated at more than 13 million residents within city limits, more than 19.1 million residents in the urban area, and more than 21.5 million residents in the metropolitan area.

city:Mexico City.title: Mexico City
city:Mexico City.text: Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico, as well as the most populous city in North America. It is one of the world's leading cultural and financial centers and, according to the Globalization and World Cities Research Network's 2024 ranking, is classified as an Alpha world city. Located in the Valley of Mexico on the high Mexican Central Plateau, the city sits at an altitude of 2,240 meters.

city:Rome.title: Rome
city:Rome.text: Rome is the capital city of Italy. It is also the capital and largest city in the region of Lazio, and the geographical region of Latium. It is on the Tiber River and has 2.8 million people.

city:Beijing.title: Beijing
city:Beijing.text: Beijing, previously romanized as Peking, is the capital city of China. With more than 21.8 million residents, it is the world's most populous national capital city, as well as China's second-largest city by urban area, after Shanghai. It is located in Northern China and is governed as a provincial-level direct-administered municipality with 16 municipal districts.

city:Nairobi.title: Nairobi
city:Nairobi.text: Nairobi is the capital and largest city of Kenya, located in the south-central part of the country. As of 2026, it has a population of 5.6 million and a metropolitan population of 15.95 million, making it the 8th most populous city in Africa and the 4th most populous metropolitan area. The city goes beyond its borders and has expanded into neighbouring counties, making it the 4th largest metropolitan area in Africa.

city:Jakarta.title: Jakarta
city:Jakarta.text: Jakarta, officially the Special Capital Region of Jakarta, is the capital and largest city of Indonesia, with administrative status equivalent to a province. It lies on the northwestern coast of Java, bordering West Java and Banten and facing the Java Sea. Jakarta covers about 664 square kilometres and had 11 million registered residents in 2025.

city:Bogota.title: Bogotá
city:Bogota.text: Bogota is the capital city of Colombia. As of 2009, more than 7 million people live in Bogota, which makes it the largest city in Colombia. It is about 2,640 metres above sea level, on a plateau.

city:Cairo.title: Cairo
city:Cairo.text: Cairo is the capital and largest city of Egypt and the Cairo Governorate. It is home to more than 9.8 million people. The city is also part of the largest urban agglomeration in Africa, the Arab world, and the Middle East.

city:Tokyo.title: Tokyo
city:Tokyo.text: Tokyo, officially the Tokyo Metropolis, is the capital and most populous city of Japan. The population of the city proper was over 14 million as of 2023. The Greater Tokyo Area, which includes Tokyo and parts of six neighboring prefectures, is the third-most populous metropolitan area in the world, with 33 million residents as of 2025.

city:Paris.title: Paris
city:Paris.text: Paris is the capital and largest city of France, with an estimated city population of 2.04 million in an area of 105.4 km2 (40.7 sq mi), as of January 2026, and a metropolitan population of 13.3 million (2023). Located on the Seine in the centre of the Île-de-France region, it is the largest metropolitan area and fourth-most populous city in the European Union (EU).

city:Santiago.title: Santiago
city:Santiago.text: Santiago is the capital of Chile and the largest city in the country. It has a population of around 7 million people, about 40 percent of the population of Chile. In Chile, people call the city Gran Santiago or Santiago.

city:Singapore.title: Singapore
city:Singapore.text: Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is a sovereign country. It is nicknamed as 'The Lion City', 'The Garden City' or 'The Little Red Dot'. It is an island state at the southern end of the Malay Peninsula in Southeast Asia, between the Straits of Malacca and the South China Sea.

city:Boston.title: Boston
city:Boston.text: Boston is the largest city of Massachusetts in the United States. It was founded in 1630. Boston is one of the oldest, richest and most culturally important cities in the United States.

city:Orlando.title: Orlando, Florida
city:Orlando.text: Orlando is a city in the center of the U.S. state of Florida. It is the county seat of Orange County. It contains 307,573 people as of 2020.

city:Miami.title: Miami
city:Miami.text: Miami is a city located on the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Florida. It is a known tourist stop and it is well known for its Cuban, Puerto Rican and Haitian culture.

city:Los Angeles.title: Los Angeles
city:Los Angeles.text: Los Angeles (L.A.), officially the City of Los Angeles, is the largest city in California, in the United States. There are many ethnicities of people living in the city, and over 18 million people in the Greater Los Angeles region. The city has an area of 460 sq mi (1,200 km2).

city:Houston.title: Houston
city:Houston.text: Houston is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Texas. It is the 4th most populous city in the United States. As of 2020, more than 2 million people lived there.

city:New York City.title: New York City
city:New York City.text: New York, often called New York City (NYC), is the most populous city in the U.S. state of New York, and the largest city in the United States. It is at the southern end of the U.S.

city:Chicago.title: Chicago
city:Chicago.text: Chicago is a city in the U.S. state of Illinois. It is the third largest city in the United States. Chicago, Illinois is the most populated city in the Midwestern United States.

city:Honolulu.title: Honolulu
city:Honolulu.text: Honolulu is the capital city of the U.S. state of Hawaii. It is also the largest city in Hawaii and it has the most important harbor.

city:Sydney.title: Sydney
city:Sydney.text: Sydney is a city on the east coast of Australia which is the capital city of New South Wales. About five and a half million people live in Sydney which makes it the biggest city in both Australia and Oceania.

city:Toronto.title: Toronto
city:Toronto.text: Toronto is the capital city of the province of Ontario. It is found on the northwest side of Lake Ontario behind New York City and Chicago. With a 2021 population of 2,794,356 people, Toronto is the most populous city in Canada and the fourth-most populous city in North America.

city:Rio de Janeiro.title: Rio de Janeiro
city:Rio de Janeiro.text: Rio de Janeiro is the second largest city in Brazil. It is the capital of the state of Rio de Janeiro. Until April 21, 1960, it was the capital city of Brazil.

city:Mumbai.title: Mumbai
city:Mumbai.text: Mumbai is a natural harbour on the west coast of India, and is the capital city of Maharashtra state.
